keyinaanu mahalalelu yeredu

gomeru kumaarulu ashkanaju reephathu thoogarmaa.
yaavaanu kumaarulu eleeshaa tharsheeshu kittheemu dodaa neemu.
haamu kumaarulu; kooshu misraayimu poothu kanaanu.
kooshu kumaarulu sebaa haveelaa sabthaa raayamaa sabthakaa. Raayamaa kumaarulu shebadadaanu.
kooshu nimrodunu kanenu, ithadu bhoomimeedi paraa kramashaalulalo modativaadu.
loodeeyulu anaamee yulu lehaabeeyulu napthuheeyulu

arvaadeeyulu semaareeyulu hamaatheeyulu athani santhathivaaru.

arpakshadu shelahunu kanenu. shelahu eberunu kanenu.
eberunaku iddaru kumaarulu puttiri, okani dinamulalo bhoomi vibhaagimpabadenu ganuka athaniki pelegu ani peru pettabadenu, athani sahodaruni peru yokthaanu.
yokthaanu almodaadunu shelapunu hasarmaavethunu yerahunu
hadoramunu oojaalunu diklaanunu
ebaalunu abeemaa yelunu shebanu
opheerunu haveelaanu yobaalunu kanenu, veerandarunu yokthaanu kumaarulu.
shemu arpakshadu shelahu eberu pelegu rayoo
seroogu naahoru terahu
abraahaamanu peru pettabadina abraamu.
abraahaamu kumaarulu,
issaaku ishmaayelu.
veeri tharamulu evanagaa ishmaayelunaku jyeshtha kumaarudu nebaayothu tharuvaatha kedaaru adbayelu mibshaamu
mishmaa doomaa mashshaa hadadu themaa
yethooru naapeeshu kedemaa; veeru ishmaayelu kumaarulu.
abraahaamuyokka upapatniyaina kethooraa kanina kumaarulu evaranagaa jimraanu yokshaanu medaanumidyaanu ishbaaku shoovahu. Yokshaanu kumaarulu shebadaanu.
midyaanu kumaarulu, eyiphaa epheru hanoku abeedaa eldaayaa; veerandarunu kethooraaku puttina kumaarulu.
abraahaamu issaakunu kanenu, issaaku kumaarulu eshaavu ishraayelu.
eshaavu kumaarulu eleephaju reyoo velu yeyooshu yaalaamu korahu.
eleephaju kumaa rulu themaanu omaaru sepo gaathaamu kanaju thimnaa amaaleku.
reyoovelu kumaarulu nahathu jerahu shammaa mijja.
sheyeeru kumaarulu lothaanu shobaalu sibyonu anaa dishonu eseru dishaanu.
lothaanu kumaa rulu horee homaamu; thimnaa lothaanunaku sahodari.
shobaalu kumaarulu alvaanu manahathu ebaalu shepo onaamu. Sibyonu kumaarulu ayyaa anaa.
anaa kumaarulalo okaniki dishonu aniperu. Dishonu kumaarulu hamraanu eshbaanu itraanu keraanu.
eseru kumaarulu bil'haanu javaanu yahakaanu. Dishaanu kumaarulu ooju araanu.
e raajunu ishraayeleeyulanu elakamunupu edomu dheshamandu elina raajulu veeru; beyoru kumaarudaina bela athani pattanamu peru dinhaabaa.
bela chanipoyina tharuvaatha bosraa oorivaadaina jerahu kumaarudaina yobaabu athaniki badulugaa raajaayenu.
yobaabu chanipoyina tharuvaatha themaaneeyula dheshapu vaadaina hushaamu athaniki badulugaa raajaayenu.
hushaamu chanipoyina tharuvaatha moyaabu dheshamuna midyaaneeyulanu hathamuchesina bededu kumaarudaina hadadu athaniki badulugaa raajaayenu; ithani pattanamu peru aveethu.
hadadu chanipoyina tharuvaatha mashrekaa oorivaadaina shavloo athaniki badulugaa raajaayenu.
shavloo chanipoyina tharuvaatha nadhi daggaranunna rahebothuvaadaina shaavoolu athaniki badulugaa raajaayenu.
shaavoolu chani poyina tharuvaatha akboru kumaarudaina bayal‌haanaanu athaniki badulugaa raajaayenu.
bayal‌haanaanu chani poyina tharuvaatha hadadu athaniki badulugaa raajaayenu; ithani pattanamu peru paayu. Ithani bhaaryaperu mehethabelu; eeme mejaahaabu kumaartheyaina matredunaku puttinadhi.
hadadu chanipoyina tharuvaatha edomu nandu undina naayakulevaranagaa thimnaa naayakudu, alvaa naayakudu, yathethu naayakudu,
ahaleebaamaanaayakudu, elaa naayakudu, peenonu naayakudu,
kanaju naayakudu, themaanu naayakudu, mibsaaru naayakudu,
magdeeyelu naayakudu, eelaamu naaya kudu; veeru edomudheshamunaku naayakulu.
ishraayelu kumaarulu; roobenu shimyonu levi yoodhaa ishshaakhaaru jebooloonu
daanu yosepu benyaameenu naphthaali gaadu aasheru.

yoodhaa kumaarulu eru onaanu shelaa. ee mugguru kanaaneeyuraalaina shooya kumaartheyandu athaniki puttiri. yoodhaaku jyeshthakumaarudaina eru yehovaa drushtiki cheddavaadainanduna aayana vaanini champenu.
mariyu athani kodalaina thaamaaru athaniki peresunu jerahunu kanenu. yoodhaa kumaarulandarunu ayidu guru.
peresu kumaarulu hesronu haamoolu.
jerahu kumaarulu ayiduguru, jimee ethaanu hemaanu kalkolu daara.
karmee kumaarulalo okaniki aakaanu ani peru; ithadu shaapagrasthamaina daanilo kontha apaharinchi ishraayeleeyulanu shramapettenu.
ethaanu kumaarulalo ajaryaa anu okadundenu.
hesronunaku puttina kumaarulu yerahmeyelu raamu keloobai.
raamu ammeenaadaabunu kanenu, ammeenaadaabu yoodhaavaariki peddayaina nayassonunu kanenu.
nayassonu shalmaanu kanenu, shalmaa boyajunu kanenu,
boyaju obedunu kanenu, obedu yeshshayini kanenu,
yeshshayi thana jyeshtha kumaarudaina eleeyaabunu rendavavaadaina abeenaadaabunu moodavavaadaina shammaanu
naalugavavaadaina nethanelunu, ayidavavaadaina raddayini
aaravavaadaina ojemunu edava vaadaina daaveedunu kanenu.
serooyaa abeegayeelu veeri akkachellendru. Serooyaa kumaarulu mugguru, abeeshai yovaabu ashaahelu.
abeegayeelu amaashaanu kanenu; ishmaayeleeyudaina yeteru amaashaaku thandri.
hesronu kumaarudaina kaalebu ajoobaa anu thana bhaaryayandunu yereeyothunandunu pillalanu kanenu. Ajoobaa kumaarulu evaranagaa yesheru shobaabu ardonu.
ajoobaa chanipoyina tharuvaatha kaalebu ephraathaanu vivaahamu chesikonagaa adhi athaniki hoorunu kanenu.
hooru oorini kanenu, oori besalelunu kanenu.
tharuvaatha hesronu gilaadu thandriyaina maakeeru kumaarthenu koodenu; thaanu aruvadhi samvatsaramula vayassugalavaadainappudu daanini vivaahamu chesikonagaa adhi athaniki segoobunu kanenu.
segoobu yaayeerunu kanenu, ithaniki gilaadu dheshamandu iruvadhimoodu patta namu lundenu.

mariyu geshooruvaarunu siriyanulunu yaayeeru pattanamulanu kenaathunu daani upapattanamu lanu aruvadhi pattanamulanu vaariyoddhanundi theesikoniri. Veerandarunu gilaadu thandriyaina maakeerunaku kumaallu.
kaalebudaina ephraathaalo hesronu chanipoyina tharuvaatha hesronu bhaaryayaina abeeyaa athaniki tekovaku thandriyaina ashshoorunu kanenu.
hesronu jyeshtha kumaarudaina yerahmeyelu kumaarulu evaranagaa jyeshthu dagu raamu boonaa orenu ojemu aheeyaa.
ataaraa anu inkoka bhaarya yerahmeyelunaku undenu, idi onaamunaku thalli.
yerahmeyelunaku jyeshthakumaarudagu raamu kumaarulu mayaju yaameenu ekeru.
onaamu kumaarulu shammayi yaadaa, shammayi kumaarulu naadaabu abeeshooru.
abeeshooru bhaaryaperu abeehayilu, adhi athaniki ahbaanunu, moleedunu kanenu.
naadaabu kumaa rulu seledu appayeemu. Seledu santhaanamulekunda chanipoyenu
appayeemu kumaarulalo ishee anu oka dundenu, ishee kumaarulalo sheshaanu anu okadundenu, sheshaanu kumaarulalo ahlayi anu okadundenu,
shammayi sahodarudaina yaadaa kumaarulu yeteru yonaathaanu;yeteru santhaanamulekunda chanipoyenu.
yonaathaanu kumaarulu pelethu jaajaa; veeru yerahme yelunaku puttinavaaru.
sheshaanunaku kumaarthele gaani kumaarulu lekapoyiri;ee sheshaanunaku yar'haa anu oka daasudundenu, vaadu aiguptheeyudu
sheshaanu thana kumaarthenu thana daasudaina yar'haaku iyyagaa adhi athaniki atthayini kanenu.
atthayi naathaanunu kanenu, naathaanu jaabaadunu kanenu,
jaabaadu eplaalunu kanenu, eplaalu obedunu kanenu,
obedu yehoonu kanenu, yehoo ajaryaanu kanenu,
ajaryaa helessunu kanenu, helessu elaashaanu kanenu,
elaashaa sismaayeeni kanenu, sismaayee shalloomunu kanenu,
shalloomu yeka myaanu kanenu, yekamyaa eleeshaamaanu kanenu.
yera hmeyelu sahodarudaina kaalebu kumaarulevaranagaa jeepu thandriyaina meshaa, yithadu athaniki jyeshthudu. Abee hebronu meshaaku kumaarudu.
hebronu kumaarulu korahu thappooya rekemu shema.
shema yorkeyaamu thandriyaina rahamunu kanenu, rekemu shammayini kanenu.
shammayi kumaarudu maayonu, ee maayonu betsoorunaku thandri.
kaalebu upapatniyaina eyiphaa haaraananu mojaanu gaajejunu kanenu, haaraanu gaajejunu kanenu.
yehdayi kumaarulu regemu yothaamu geshaanu peletu eyiphaa shayapu.
kaalebu upapatniyaina mayakaa sheberunu thir'hanaanu kanenu.
mariyu adhi madmannaaku thandriyaina shayapunu makbe naakunu gibyaaku thandriyaina shevaanunu kanenu. Kaalebu kumaartheku aksaa ani peru.
ephraathaaku jyeshthudugaa puttina hooru kumaarudaina kaalebu kumaarulu evaranagaa kiryatyaareemu thandriyaina shobaalunu,
betlehemu thandriyaina shalmaayunu, betgaadheru thandriyaina haare punu.
kiryatyaareemu thandriyaina shobaalu kumaaruleva ranagaa haaroye hajeehameemanu hothu.
kiryatyaareemukumaarulevaranagaa itreeyulunu pootheeyulunu shummaa theeyulunu mishraayeeyulunu; veerivalana soraatheeyu lunu eshthaayuleeyulunu kaligiri.
shalmaa kumaaruleva ranagaa betlehemunu netopaatheeyulunu yovaabu inti sambandhamaina athaarotheeyulunu maanahatheeyulalo oka bhaagamugaanunna jaareeyulunu.
yabbejulo kaapuramunna lekhikula vanshamulaina thiraatheeyulunu shimyaatheeyulunu shookotheeyulunu; veeru rekaabu inti vaariki thandriyaina hamaathuvalana puttina keneeyula sambandhulu.
daaveedunaku hebronulo puttina kumaarulevaranagaa yejreyeleeyuraalaina aheenoyamunaku puttina amnonu jyeshthudu; karmeleeyuraalaina abeegayeelunaku puttina daaniyelu rendavavaadu,
geshooru raajaina thalmayi kumaartheyaina mayakaaku puttina abshaalomu moodavavaadu, haggeethu kumaarudaina adoneeyaa naalgava vaadu,
abeetalu kanina shephatya ayidavavaadu, athani bhaaryayaina eglaakanina itreyaamu aaravavaadu,
ee aaruguru hebronulo athaniki puttiri, acchata athadu edu samvatsaramula aarunelalu elenu,

yeroosha lemulo muppadhi moodu samvatsaramulu elenu. Yerooshalemulo athaniki puttina vaarevaranagaa ameemayelu kumaarthe yaina batshebavalana kaligina shimyaa shobaabu naathaanu solomonu anu naluguru
ibhaaru eleeshaamaa eleepeletu nogahu nepegu yaapheeya eleeshaamaa
elyaadaa eleepeletu anu tommandru kumaarulu.
upapatnulavalana kaliginavaarugaaka veerandaru daaveedunaku jananamairi; thaamaaru veeriki sahodari.
solomonunaku rehabaamu kumaarudu, athani kumaarudu abeeyaa.
abee yaaku aasaa kumaarudu, aasaaku yehoshaapaathu kumaa rudu
yehoshaapaathunaku yehoraamu kumaarudu, yehoraamunaku ahajyaa kumaarudu, ahajyaaku yovaashu kumaarudu,
yovaashunaku amajyaa kumaarudu amajyaaku ajaryaa kumaarudu, ajaryaaku yothaamu kumaarudu
yothaamunaku aahaaju kumaa rudu, aahaajunaku hijkiyaa kumaarudu, hijkiyaaku manashshe kumaarudu,
manashsheku aamonu kumaarudu, aamonunaku yosheeyaa kumaarudu.
yosheeyaa kumaarulevaranagaa jyeshthudu yohaanaanu, rendavavaadu yehoyaakeemu, moodavavaadu sidkiyaa, naalgavavaadu shalloomu.
yehoyaakeemu kumaarulalo yekonyaa anu okadundenu, athani kumaarudu sidkiyaa.
yakonyaa kumaarulu asseeru shayaltheeyelu
malkee raamu pedaayaa shenajjaru yekamyaa hoshaamaa nedabyaa.
pedaayaa kumaarulu jerubbaabelu shimee; jerubbaabelu kumaarulu meshullaamu hananyaa; shelomeethu vaariki sahodari.
hashubaa ohelu berekyaahasadyaa yooshabes'hedu anu mari yayidugurundiri.
hananyaa kumaarulu pelatyaa yeshayaa, rephaayaa kumaarulunu arnaanu kumaarulunu obadyaa kumaarulunu shekanyaa kumaarulunu.
shekanyaa kumaarulalo shemayaa anu okadundenu; shemayaa kumaarulu aaruguru. Hattooshu igaalu baariyahu neyaryaa shaapaathu.
neyaryaa kumaarulu mugguru. Elyoyenai hijkiyaa ajreekaamu;
elyoyenai kumaarulu eduguru; hodavyaa elyaasheebu pelaayaa akkoobu yohaanaanu delaayyaa anaani.
yoodhaa kumaarulevaranagaa peresu heshronu karmee hooru shobaalu.
shobaalu kumaarudaina revaayaa yahathunu kanenu, yahathu ahoomaini lahadunu kanenu, ivi soraatheeyula vanshamulu.
abeeyethaamu santhathivaa revaranagaa yejreyelu ishmaa idbaashu veeri sahodari peru hajjelelponi.
mariyu gedoreeyulaku pitharudagu penooyelunu hooshaayeeyulaku pitharudagu ejerunu, veeru betlehemunaku thandriyaina ephraathaaku jyeshthudagu hoorunaku kumaarulu.
tekova thandriyaina ashshooru naku helaa nayaraa anu iddaru bhaaryalundiri.
nayaraa athaniki ahujaamunu heperunu themaneeni haaya hashthaareeni kanenu. Veeru nayaraaku puttina kumaa rulu.
helaa kumaaru levaranagaa jerethu soharu etnaanu.
koju aanoobunu jobebaanu haarumu kumaarudaina ahar'heluyokka vanshamulanu kanenu.
yabbeju thana sahodarulakante ghanamu pondinavaadai yundenu vedhanapadi yithani kantinani athani thalli athaniki yabbeju ani perupettenu.

yabbeju ishraayelee yula dhevunigoorchi morrapettineevu nannu nishchayamugaa aasheervadhinchi naa sarihaddunu vishaala parachi nee cheyyi naaku thoodugaa unda dayachesi naaku keeduraakunda daanilonundi nannu thappinchumu ani praarthimpagaa dhevudu athadu manavichesina daanini athaniki dayachesenu.
shoovahu sahodarudaina keloobu eshthoonunaku thandriyaina meheerunu kanenu.
eshthoonu betraaphaanu paaseyanu eernaahaashunaku thandriyaina tehinnaanu kanenu, veeru rekaavaaru.
kanaju kumaarulu otneeyelu sheraayaa; otneeyelu kumaarulalo hathathu anu oka dundenu.
meyaanothai ophraanu kanenu, sheraayaa panivaari loyalo nivasinchuvaariki thandriyaina yovaa bunu kanenu, aa loyalonivaaru panivaarai yundiri.
yephunne kumaarudaina kaalebu kumaarulu eeroo elaa nayamu; elaa kumaarulalo kanaju anu okadundenu.
yehallelelu kumaarulu jeephu jeephaa theeryaa asharyelu.
ejraa kumaarulu yeteru meredu epheru yaalonu; meredu bhaarya miryaamunu shammayini eshtemonu vaariki peddayayina ishbaahunu kanenu.

athani bhaaryayaina yehoodeeyaa gedorunaku pradhaaniyaina yere dunu shokoku pradhaaniyaina heberunu jaanohaku pradhaaniyaina yekootheeyelunu kanenu. Meredu vivaahamu chesikonina pharo kumaartheyaina bityaaku puttina kumaarulu veere.
mariyu nahamu sahodariyaina hoodeeyaa bhaaryayokka kumaarulevaranagaa garmeeyu daina keyeelaa maayakaatheeyudaina eshtemo.
sheemonu kumaarulu amnonu rinnaa benhaanaanu theelonu. Ishee kumaarulu johethu benjohethu.
yoodhaa kumaarudaina shelahu kumaarulevaranagaa lekaaku pradhaaniyaina eru maareshaaku pradhaaniyaina laddaayu; sannapu vastramulu neyu ashbeya yinti vanshakulakunu
yokee meeyulakunu koje baayeeyulakunu yovaashuvaarikini moyaabulo prabhutvamu nondina shaaraapeeyulakunu yaashoo bilehemuvaarikini athadu pitharudu; ivi poorva kaalapu sangathule.
vaaru kummarivaandlayi nethaayeemu nandunu gedheraanandunu kaapuramundiri; raaju niyamamu chetha athanipani vichaarinchutakai acchata kaapuramundiri.
shimyonu kumaarulu nemooyelu yaameenu yaareebu jerahu shaavoolu.
shaavoolunaku shalloomu kumaarudu, shalloomunaku mibshaamu kumaarudu, mibshaa munaku mishmaa kumaarudu.
mishmaa kumaarulalo okadu hammooyelu; hammooyelunaku jakkooru kumaarudu, jakkoorunaku shimee kumaarudu.
shimeeki padunaaruguru kumaarulunu aaruguru kumaarthelunu kaligiri; ayithe athani sahodarulaku enthoo mandi kumaarulu kalugaledu; yoodhaavaaru vruddhiyainatlu vaari vanshamulanniyu vruddhikaaledu.
vaaru beyershebaalonu molaadaalonu hajarshuvalulonu
bil'haalonu ejemulonu thoolaadulonu bethooyelulonu
hormaalonu siklagulonu betmarkaabothulonu haajarsoosaalonu betbeereelonu sharaayimulonu kaapuramundiri.
daaveedu elubadi varaku vaaru aa pattanamulalo kaapuramundiri.
ethaamu ayeenu rimmonu thookenu aashaanu anuvaari oollu ayidu.
bayaluvaraku aa pattanamula polamulu vaari vashamuna undenu; ivi vaari nivaasasthalamulu, vamshaavali patteelu vaarikundenu.
vaaru meshobaabu yamleku amajyaa kumaarudaina yoshaa,
yovelu asheeyelu kumaarudaina sheraayaaku puttina yoshibyaa kumaarudaina yehoo.
elyoyenai yahakobaa yeshohaayaa ashaayaa adeeyelu yesheemeeyelu benaayaa;
shemayaaku puttina shimee kumaarudaina yedaayaaku puttina allonu kumaarudaina shipi kumaarudaina jeejaa anuvaaru.
pellavarusanu vraayabadina veeru thamathama vanshamulalo peddalaiyundiri; veeri pitharula yindlu bahugaa vardhillenu.
veeru thama mandalakoraku metha vedakutakai gedorunaku thoorpunanunna pallapusthalamunaku poyi
manchi balakaramaina methayu nemmadhiyu sukhamunugala vishaaladheshamunu kanugoniri; poorva mandu haamuyokka vanshapuvaaru akkada kaapura mundiri.

pellavarusanu vraayabadiyundu veeru yoodhaa raajaina hijkiyaa dinamulalo acchatiki vachi acchata kanabadinavaari gudaaramulanu nivaasasthalamulanu padagotti vaarini hathamuchesi, acchata thama gorrelaku thagina metha kaligiyundutachetha netivaraku vaari sthaanamulanu aakraminchukoni yunnaaru.
shimyonu kumaarulaina veerilo aiduvandalamandi thamapaini ishee kumaarulaina pelatyaanu neyaryaanu rephaayaanu ujjeeyelunu adhi pathulagaa nirnayinchukoni sheyeeru mannemunaku poyi
amaalekeeyulalo thappinchukonina sheshamunu hathamuchesi netivaraku acchata kaapuramunnaaru.

ishraayelunaku tolichooli kumaarudaina roobenu kumaarula vivaramu. Ithadu jyeshthudai yundenu gaani thana thandri parupunu thaanu antuparachinanduna athani janma svaathantryamu ishraayelu kumaarudaina yosepu kumaa rulakiyyabadenu; ayithe vamshaavalilo yosepu jyeshthu dugaa daakhalucheyabadaledu.
yoodhaa thana sahoda rulakante hechinavaadaayenu, athaninundi pramukhudu bayaluvedalenu, ayinanu janmasvaathantryamu yosepu daayenu.
ishraayelunaku jyeshthudugaa puttina roobenu kumaaru levaranagaa hanoku pallu hesronu karmee.
yovelu kumaarulalo okadu shemayaa, shemayaaku gogu kumaarudu, gogunaku shimee kumaarudu,
shimeeki meekaa kumaarudu, meekaaku revaayaa kumaarudu, revaayaaku bayalu kumaarudu,
bayalunaku beyera kumaarudu, ithadu roobeneeyulaku pedda. Ashshooru raajaina thiglatpileseru athani cheratheesikoni poyenu.
vaari tharamula vamshaavali sarichoodabadinappudu vaari kutumba mula choppuna athani sahodarulalo mukhyulugaa thelinavaaru yeheeyelunu, jekaryaayunu,
yovelu kumaarudaina shemaku puttina aajaaju kumaarudaina bela yunu. Bela vanshapuvaaru aroyerunandunu nebo varakunu bayalmeyonuvarakunu kaapuramundiri.
vaari pashuvulu gilaadudheshamandu athivisthaaramu kaagaa thoorpuna yoophrateesunadhi modalukoni aranyapu sarihadduvarakunu vaaru kaapuramundiri.
saulu dinamulalo vaaru hagree yeelathoo yuddhamu jariginchi vaarini hathamuchesi gilaadu thoorpuvaipuvaraku vaari gudaaramulalo kaapuramundiri.
gaadu vanshasthulu vaarikedurugaa baashaanu dheshamandu salkaavaraku kaapuramundiri.
vaarilo yovelu tegavaaru mukhyulu, rendava tegavaaru shaapaamuvaaru. shaapaamuvaarunu yahanaivaarunu shaapaathuvaarunu baashaanulo undiri.
vaari pitharula yintivaaraina vaari sahodarulu eduguru, mikhaayelu meshullaamu shebayorai yakaanu jeeya eberu.
veeru hooree anuvaaniki puttina abeehaayilu kumaarulu. ee hooree yaroyaku yaaroya gilaadunaku gilaadu mikhaayelu naku mikhaayelu yesheeshaiki yesheeshai yahadoku yahado boojunaku puttiri.
goonee kumaarudaina abdee yelunaku puttina ahee vaari pitharula yindlavaariki pedda.
vaaru baashaanulonunna gilaadunandunu daani graamamulayandunu shaaronunaku cherikaina upagraamamula yandunu daani praanthamulavaraku kaapuramundiri.
veerandaru yoodhaa raajaina yothaamu dinamulalonu ishraayelu raajaina yarobaamu dinamulalonu thama vamshaavalula varusanu lekkalo cherchabadiri.

roobeneeyulalonu gaadeeyulalonu manashshe ardha gotramuvaarilonu ballemunu khadgamunu dharinchutakunu ambuveyutakunu nerchinavaaru, yuddhamandu nerparulai danduku pothaginavaaru naluvadhi naaluguvela eduvandala aruvadhimandi yundiri.
veeru hagreeyeelathoonu yethooruvaarithoonu naapeeshu vaarithoonu nodaabuvaarithoonu yuddhamuchesiri.
yuddhamandu vaaru dhevuniki morrapettagaa, aayanameeda vaaru nammikayunchinanduna aayana vaari morra aalakinchenu

ganuka vaarini jayinchu taku vaariki sahaayamu kaligenu. Hagreeyeelunu vaarithoo unnavaarandarunu vaarichethiki appagimpabadiri; vaaru ebadhi vela ontelanu pashuvulanu rendulakshala ebadhivela gorrelanu renduvela gaadidalanu laksha janamunu pattukoniri.

yuddhamandu dhevuni sahaayamu vaariki kalugutachetha shatruvulu anekulu padipoyiri; thaamu cheratheesikoni pobadu varaku roobeneeyulunu gaadeeyulunu manashshe ardhagotramuvaarunu veeri sthaanamulayandu kaapuramundiri.
manashshe ardhagotramuvaarunu aa dheshamandu kaapura mundi vardhilluchu, baashaanu modalukoni bayal'hermonu varakunu sheneeruvarakunu hermonu parvathamu varakunu vyaapinchiri.
vaari pitharula yindlaku peddalainavaarevaranagaa epheru ishee eleeyelu ajreeyelu yirmeeyaa hodavyaa yahadeeyelu; veeru keerthipondina paraakramashaalulai thama pitharula yindlaku peddalairi.
ayithe vaaru thama pitharula dhevunimeeda thirugubaatuchesi, dhevudu thama mundhara naashanamu chesina janasamoohamula dhevathalathoo vyabhicharinchiri.

kaabatti ishraayeleeyula dhevudu ashshooru raajaina poolu manassunu ashshooru raajaina thiglatpileseru manassunu repagaa athadu roobeneeyulanu gaadeeyulanu manashshe ardhagotramuvaarini cherapatti netikini kanabadu chunnatlugaa haalahunakunu haaborunakunu haaraakunu gojaanu nadeepraanthamulakunu vaarini konipoyenu.
levi kumaarulu gershonu kahaathu meraari.
kahaathu kumaarulu amraamu is'haaru hebronu ujjeeyelu.
amraamu kumaarulu aharonu moshe, kumaarthe miryaamu. Aharonu kumaarulu naadaabu abeehu eliyaajaru eethaamaaru.
eliyaajaru pheenehaasunu kanenu, pheenehaasu abeeshoovanu kanenu,
abee shoova bukkeeni kanenu, bukkee ujjeeni kanenu,
ujjee jerahyaanu kanenu, jerahyaa meraayothunu kanenu,
meraayothu amaryaanu kanenu, amaryaa aheetoobunu kanenu,
aheetoobu saadokunu kanenu, saadoku ahimayassunu kanenu,
ahimayassu ajaryaanu kanenu, ajaryaa yohaanaanunu kanenu,
yohaanaanu ajaryaanu kanenu, ithadu solomonu yerooshalemulo kattinchina mandiramandu yaajakatvamu jariginchinavaadu.
ajaryaa amaryaanu kanenu, amaryaa aheetoobunu kanenu,
aheetoobu saadokunu kanenu, saadoku shalloomunu kanenu,
shalloomu hilkeeyaanu kanenu, hilkeeyaa ajaryaanu kanenu,
ajaryaa sheraayaanu kanenu, sheraayaa yehojaadaakunu kanenu.
yehovaa nebu kadnejarudvaaraa yoodhaavaarini yerooshalemuvaarini cheratheesikoni poyinappudu ee yehojaadaaku cheraloniki poyenu.
levi kumaarulu gershonu kahaathu meraari.
gershonu kumaarula pellu libnee shimee.
kahaathu kumaarulu amraamu is'haaru hebronu ujjeeyelu.
meraari kumaarulu mahali mooshi; vaari pitharula varusalanubatti leveeyula kutumbamulu evanagaa
gershonu kumaarudu libnee, libnee kumaarudu yahathu, yahathu kumaarudu jimmaa,
jimmaa kumaarudu yovaahu, yovaahu kumaarudu iddo, iddo kumaarudu jerahu, jerahu kumaarudu yeyathirayi.
kahaathu kumaarulalo okadu ammeenaadaabu, veeni kumaarudu korahu, korahu kumaarudu asseeru,
asseeru kumaarudu elkaanaa, elkaanaa kumaarudu ebyaasaapu, ebyaasaapu kumaarudu asseeru,
asseeru kumaarudu thaahathu, thaahathu kumaarudu ooriyelu, ooriyelu kumaarudu ujjiyaa, ujjiyaa kumaarudu shaavoolu.
elkaanaa kumaarulu amaashai aheemothu.
elkaanaa kumaarulalo okadu jopai. Jopai kumaarudu nahathu,
nahathu kumaarudu eleeyaabu, eleeyaabu kumaarudu yerohaamu, yero haamu kumaarudu elkaanaa.
samooyelu kumaarulu jyeshthudagu vashniyu abeeyaayu.
meraari kumaaru lalo okadu mahali, mahali kumaarudu libnee, libnee kumaarudu shimee, shimee kumaarudu ujjaa
ujjaa kumaa rudu shimyaa, shimyaa kumaarudu haggeeyaa, haggeeyaa kumaarudu ashaayaa.
nibandhana mandasamunaku sthalamu erpaataina tharuvaatha yehovaa mandiramandu sangeetha sevakoraku daaveedu niyaminchinavaaru veere.
solomonu yerooshalemulo yehovaa mandiramunu kattinchuvaraku veeru samaajapu gudaaramuyokka mungita sangeethasevanu aacharinchuchundiri; vaaru vanthulachoppuna thama pani choochukonuchundiri.
ee prakaaramu thama kumaarulathoo kalasi kani pettuchunnavaarevaranagaa, kahatheeyula kumaarulalo gaayakudagu hemaanu; ithadu samooyelu kumaarudagu yovelunaku puttinavaadu
samooyelu elkaanaaku puttenu, elkaanaa yerohaamunaku puttenu, yerohaamu eleeyelunaku puttenu, eleeyelu thooya hunaku puttenu,
thooyahu soopunaku puttenu, soopu elkaanaaku puttenu, elkaanaa mahathunaku puttenu, mahathu amaashaiki puttenu,
amaashai elkaanaaku puttenu, elkaanaa yovelunaku puttenu, yovelu ajaryaaku puttenu, ajaryaa jephanyaaku puttenu,
jephanyaa thaahathunaku puttenu, thaahathu asseerunaku puttenu, asseeru ebyaasaapunaku puttenu, ebyaasaapu korahunaku puttenu,
korahu is'haarunaku puttenu, is'haaru kahaathunaku puttenu, kahaathu leviki puttenu, levi ishraayelunaku puttenu.
hemaanu sahodarudaina aasaapu ithani kudiprakkanu niluchuvaadu. ee aasaapu berakyaa kumaarudu, berakyaa shimyaa kumaarudu,
shimyaa mikhaayelu kumaarudu, mikhaayelu bayasheyaa kumaarudu,bayasheyaa malkeeyaa kumaarudu,
malkeeyaa yetnee kumaarudu, yetnee jerahu kumaarudu, jerahu adaayaa kumaarudu,
adaayaa ethaanu kumaarudu, ethaanu jimmaa kumaarudu, jimmaa shimee kumaarudu,
shimee yahathu kumaarudu, yahathu gershonu kumaarudu, gershonu levi kumaarudu.
meraareeyulu edamaprakkanu niluchuvaaru; vaarilo ethaanu keeshee kumaarudu, keeshee abdee kumaarudu, abdee mallooku kumaarudu, mallooku hashabyaa kumaarudu,
hashabyaa amajyaa kumaarudu, amajyaa hilkeeyaa kumaarudu,
hilkeeyaa aveeju kumaarudu, aveeju baanee kumaarudu, baanee shameru kumaarudu,
shameru mahali kumaarudu, mahali mooshi kumaarudu, mooshi meraari kumaarudu, meraari levi kumaarudu.
veeri sahodarulaina leveeyulu dhevuni mandirasthalamuthoo sambandhinchina sakalamaina panulaku nirnayimpabadiri.

ayithe aharonunu athani santhathivaarunu dahana balipeethamumeedanu dhoopapeethamumeedanu dhoopamuveyuchu, athiparishuddhasthalapu paninanthatini jarupu chundavalenaniyu, dhevuni sevakudaina moshe aagnaapinchina anthatichoppuna ishraayeleeyula nimitthamu praayashchitthamu cheyuchunda valenaniyu vaariki nirnayamaayenu.
aharonu kumaaru lalo eli yaajaru anu okadundenu; veeni kumaarudu pheenehaasu, pheenehaasu kumaarudu abeeshoova,
abeeshoova kumaarudu bukkee, bukkee kumaarudu ujjee, ujjee kumaarudu jerahya,
jerahya kumaarudu meraayothu, meraayothu kumaarudu amaryaa, amaryaa kumaarudu aheetoobu,
aheetoobu kumaarudu saadoku, saadoku kumaarudu ahimayassu.
aharonu santhathivaaragu kahaatheeyulu vanthuvaaru; vaari kutumbamula polimeralalo vaaru vidisina thaavulanubatti vaariki erpadina nivaasasthalamulu ivi.
yoodhaa dheshamuloni hebronunu daani chuttununna yupa graamamulunu vaarikappagimpabadenu.
ayithe aa pattanapu polamulunu daani graamamulunu yephunne kumaarudaina kaalebunaku iyyabadenu.
aharonu santhathivaariki vachina pattanamulevanagaa aashraya pattanamaina hebronu libnaa daani graamamulu, yattheeru eshtemo daani graamamulu,
heelenu daani graamamulu, debeeru daani graamamulu,
aashaanu daani graama mulu, betshemeshu daani graamamulu.
mariyu benyaameenu gotrasthaanamuloni geba daani graamamulu, allemethu daani graamamulu, anaathoothu daani graamamulu, veeri vanshamulaku kaligina pattanamulanniyu padumoodu.
kahaathu gotreeyulalo sheshinchinavaariki ephraayimu gotrasthaanamulonundiyu, daanu ardhagotra sthaanamulonundiyu, manashshe ardhagotra sthaanamulo nundiyu chitichetha padhi pattanamulu iyyabadenu.

gershonu santhathivaariki vaari vanshamulachoppuna ishshaa khaaru gotrasthaanamulonundiyu, aasheru gotrasthaana mulonundiyu, naphthaali gotrasthaanamulo nundiyu baashaanunandundu manashshe gotrasthaanamulonundiyu padumoodu pattanamulu iyyabadenu.
meraareeyulaku vaari vanshamulachoppuna roobenu gotrasthaanamulonundiyu, gaadu gotrasthaanamulonundiyu, jebooloonu gotrasthaanamulonundiyu chitichetha pandrendu pattanamulu iyyabadenu.
ee prakaaramugaa ishraayeleeyulu leveeyulaku ee pattanamulanu vaati graama mulanu ichiri.
vaaru chitivesi yoodhaavaari gotrasthaanamulonundiyu, shimyoneeyula gotrasthaanamulo nundiyu, benyaameeneeyula gotrasthaanamulonundiyu peru perugaa cheppabadina aa pattanamulanu ichiri.
kahaatheeyulalo kondariki ephraayimu gotramulo polimera pattanamulu kaligiyundenu.
aashraya pattana mulunu ephraayimu parvathamuloni shekemunu daavi graamamulunu, gejerunu daani graamamulunu,
yokme yaamunu daani graamamulunu bet‌horonunu daani graamamulunu,
ayyaalonunu daani graamamulunu gatrimmonunu daani graamamulunu vaari kiyyabadenu.
mariyu manashshe ardhagotrasthaanamulonundi aanerunu daani graamamulanu biliyaamunu daani graamamulanu kahaatheeyulaku ichiri.
mariyu gershomeeyulaku manashshe ardhagotravanshasthaanamulonundi baashaanunandali golaanudaani graamamulu, ashthaarothu daani graamamulu,
ishshaa khaarugotrasthaanamulonundi kedeshu daani graamamulu, daaberathu daani graamamulu,
raamothu daani graamamulu, aanemu daani graamamulu,
aasheru gotrasthaana mulonundi maashaalu daani graamamulu, abdonu daani graamamulu,
hukkoku daani graamamulu rehobu daani graamamulu;
naphthaali gotrasthaanamulonundi gali layalonunna kedeshu daani graamamulu, hammonu daani graamamulu, kiryathaayimu daani graamamulu iyyabadenu.
mariyu meraareeyulalo sheshinchinavaariki jeboo loonu gotrasthaanamulonundi rimmonu daani graamamulu, thaaborudaani graamamulu,
yerikoku aavala yordaanunaku thoorpugaa undu roobenu gotrasthaanamulonundi ara nyamuloni beseru daani graamamulu, yahajaayu daani graamamulu,
kedhemothu daani graamamulu, mephaathu daani graamamulu,
gaadu gotra sthaanamulonundi gilaaduyandali raamothu daani graamamulu, mahanayeemu daani graamamulu,
heshbonu daani graamamulu, yaajeru daani graamamulu, iyyabadenu.
ishshaakhaaru kumaarulu naluguru. Vaaru thoolaa puvvaa yaashoobu shimronu anuvaaru

thoolaa kumaarulu ujjee rephaayaa yereeyelu yahmayi yibshaamu shemooyelu; thoolaaku puttina veeru thama pitharula yindlaku peddalu; veeru thama tharamulalo paraakrama shaalulai yundiri; daaveedu dinamulalo veeri sankhyayiruvadhi renduvela aaruvandalu.
ujjee kumaarulalo okadu ijrahayaa. Ijrahayaa kumaarulu mikhaayelu obadyaa yovelu ishsheeyaa; veeru ayiduguru peddalai yundiri.
vaariki bahumandi bhaaryalunu pillalunu kaligi yundutachetha vaari pitharula yindla lekkanu vaari vanshamulalo senaku cherinavaaru muppadhi aaruvelamandi yundiri.
mariyu ishshaakhaaru vanshamulannitilo vaari sahodarulaina paraakramashaalulandaru thama vamshaavalula choppuna enubadhi yeduvelamandi yundiri.
benyaameenu kumaarulu mugguru; bela bekaru yedeeya velu.
bela kumaarulu ayiduguru; esbonu ujjee ujjeeyelu yereemothu eeree. Veeru thama pitharula yindlaku peddalu, paraakramashaalulu; veeri vanshamulo cherinavaaru iruvadhi renduvela muppadhi naluguru.
bekaru kumaarulu jemeeraa yovaashu eleeyejeru elyoyenai omee yereemothu abeeyaa anaathoothu aalemethu; veerandarunu bekaru kumaarulu.
veeru thama pitharula yindlaku peddalu, paraakramashaalulu, veerandarunu iruvadhivela renduvandalu.
yedeeyavelu kumaarulalo okadu bil'haanu. Bil'haanu kumaarulu yooshu benyaameenu ehoodu kenayanaa jethaanu tharsheeshu aheeshaharu.
yedeeya velu kumaarulaina veerandarunu thama pitharula yindlaku peddalu; veerilo yuddha munaku pothagina paraakrama shaalulu padunaiduvela rendu vandalamandi yundiri.
shuppeemu huppeemu eeru kumaarulu, aheru kumaarulalo husheemu anu oka dundenu.
naphthaaleeyulu bil'haakuputtina yahasayelu goonee yeseru shillemu.
manashshe kumaarulalo ashreeyelanu okadundenu. Siriyaa dheshasthuraalaina upapatni athani kanenu, adhi gilaadu naku peddayaina maakeerunu kooda kanenu.
maakeeru, huppeemu, shuppeemula sodarini pendli yaadenu. daani sahodari peru mayakaa, rendavavaaniki selopehaadani peru, ee selopehaaduku kumaarthelu maatramu puttiri.
maakeeru bhaaryayaina mayakaa oka kumaaruni kani athaniki pereshu anu perupettenu, ithani sahodaruni peru pereshu, athani kumaarulu oolaamu raakemu.
oolaamu kumaarulalo bedaanu anu okadundenu; veeru manashshe kumaarudaina maakeerunaku puttina gilaadu kumaarulu.
maakeerunaku sahodariyaina hammolekethu ishodunu abeeyejerunu mahalaanu kanenu.
shemeedaa kumaarulu aheyaanu shekemu likee aneeyaamu.
ephraayimu kumaarulalo shoothalahu anu oka dundenu; athaniki beredu kumaarudu, beredunaku thaahathu kumaarudu, thaahathunaku elaadaa kumaarudu, elaadaaku thaahathu kumaarudu,

thaahathunaku jaabaadu kumaarudu. Veeniki shoothalahu ejeru elyaadu anuvaaru puttiri; vaaru thama dheshamulo puttina gaatheeyula pashuvulanu pattu konipovutaku digi raagaa aa gaatheeyulu vaarini champiri.
vaari thandriyaina ephraayimu anekadhinamulu duḥkhinchu chundagaa athani sahodarulu vachi athani paraamarshinchiri.
tharuvaatha athadu thana bhaaryanu koodagaa adhi garbhamu dharinchi yoka kumaaruni kanenu;thana yintiki keedu kaligi nanduna ephraayimu athaniki bereeyaa anu peru pettenu.
athani kumaartheyaina sheyeraa uttharapu bet‌ horonunu dakshinapu bet‌ horonunu ujjen‌ sheyeraanu kattinchenu.
vaani kumaarulu repahu reshepu; repahu kumaa rudu telahu, telahu kumaarudu thahanu,
thahanu kumaarudu laddaanu, laddaanu kumaarudu ameehoodu, ameehoodu kumaarudu eleeshaamaa,
eleeshaamaa kumaarudu noonu, noonu kumaarudu yehoshuva.

vaariki svaasthyamulaina nivaasasthalamulu bethelu daani graamamulu thoorpunanunna naharaanu padamatanunna gejeru daani graamamulu, shekemu daani graamamulu, gaajaa daani graamamulunu unnanthavaraku vyaapinchenu.

mariyu manashsheeyula prakkanunna betsheyaanu daani graama mulu, thaanaaku daani graamamulu, megiddo daani graamamulu, doru daani graamamulu vaarikundenu, ee sthalamulalo ishraayelu kumaarudaina yosepu santhathi vaaru kaapuramundiri.
aashereeyulu imnaa ishvaa ishvee bereeyaa. sherahu veeriki sahodari.
bereeyaa kumaarulu heberu malkeeyelu, malkeeyelu birjaayeethunaku thandri.
heberu yapletunu shomerunu hothaamunu veeri sahodariyaina shooyaanu kanenu.
yapletu kumaaru levaranagaa paasaku binhaalu ashvaathu, veeru yapletunaku kumaarulu.
shomeru kumaarulu ahee rogaa yehubbaa araamu.
vaani sahodarudaina helemu kumaarulu jopahu imnaa sheleshu aamaalu.
jopahu kumaarulu sooya harneperu shooyaalu beree imraa
beseru hodu shammaa shilshaa itraanu beyera.
eteru kumaarulu yephunne pispaa araa.
ullaa kumaarulu aarahu hanniyelu rijeyaa.

aasheru santhathivaaraina veerandarunu thama pitharula yindlaku peddalunu prakhyaathi nondina paraakramashaalulunu adhipathulalo mukhyulunai yundiri. aa vanshapuvaarilo yuddhamunaku pothaginavaari lekka yiruvadhi yaaruvelu.
banyaameenu kanina kumaarulalo bela anuvaadu jyeshthudu, rendavavaadu ashbelu,
moodavavaadu aharahu, naalgavavaadu nohaa, ayidavavaadu raapaa.
belaku puttina kumaarulu addaaru geraa abeehoodu
abeeshoova nayamaanu ahoyahu
geraa shepoopaanu hooraamu
ehoodu kanina kumaarulu ujjaa ahee hoodu, vaaru geba kaapurasthulaku inti peddalugaa nundiri;
nayamaanu aheeyaa geraa anuvaaru vaarini manahathunaku cheratheesikoni poyiri, geraa vaarini acchatiki cheratheesikoni poyenu.
vaarini pampivesina tharuvaatha shaharayeemu moyaabu dheshamandu husheemu bayaraa anu thana bhaaryalayandu kanina pillalugaaka
thana bhaaryayaina hodeshunandu yobaabunu jibyaanu meshaanu malkaamunu
yepoojunu shaakyaanu mirmaanu kanenu, veeru athani kumaarulu; vaaru thama pitharula yindlaku peddalugaa undiri.
husheemu anu daaniyandu athadu aheetoobunu elpayalunu kanenu.
elpayalu kumaarulu eberu mishaamu shemedu, shemedu ononu lodunu daani graamamulanu kattinchenu.
bereeyaayunu shemayunu ayyaalonu kaapurasthulayokka pitharulalo peddalu; veeru gaatheeyulanu paaradoliri.
ahyoshaashaku yeremothu
jebadyaa araadu ederu
mikhaayelu ishpaa yohaa anuvaaru bereeyaa kumaarulu.
jebadyaa meshullaamu hijiki heberu
ishmerai ijleeyaa yobaabu anuvaaru elpayalunaku kumaarulu.
yaakeemu jikhree jibdi
eleeyenai jillethai eleeyelu.
adaayaa beraayaa shimraathu anuvaaru shimeeki kumaa rulu.
ishpaanu eberu eleeyelu
abdonu jikhree haanaanu
hananyaa elaamu anthootheeyaa
ipedayaa penooyelu anuvaaru shaashaku kumaarulu.
shansherai sheharyaa athalyaa
yahareshyaa eleeyyaa jikhree anu vaaru yerohaamu kumaarulu.
veeru thama thama tharamu lannitilo pitharula yindlaku peddalunu, pramukhulunai yundi yerooshalemunandu kaapuramundiri.
gibiyonunaku thandriyainavaadu gibiyonulo kaapura mundenu. Ithani bhaaryaperu mayakaa;
ithani pedda kumaarudu abdonu, migilinavaaru sooru keeshu bayalu naadaabu
gedoru ahyo jekeru anuvaaru.
miklothu shimyaanu kanenu. Veerunu thama sahodarulathoo kooda vaariki edurugaanunna yindlalone yerooshalemu nandu kaapuramundiri.
neru keeshunu kanenu, keeshu saulunu kanenu, saulu yonaathaanunu malkeeshoovanu abeenaadaabunu eshbayalunu kanenu.
yonaathaanu kumaarudu mereebbayalu, mereebbayalu meekaanu kanenu.
meekaa kumaarulu peethoonu meleku thareya aahaaju.
aahaaju yehoyaadaanu kanenu, yehoyaada aalemethunu ajmaavethunu jimeeni kanenu, jimee mojaanu kanenu.
mojaa binyaanu kanenu, binyaaku raapaa kumaarudu, raapaaku elaashaa kumaarudu, elaashaaku aajelu kumaarudu.
aajelu kumaarulu aaruguru; vaari pellu ajreekaamu bokeru ishmaayelu sheyaryaa obadyaa haanaanu veerandarunu aajelu kumaarulu.
athani sahodaru daina esheku kumaarulu mugguru; oolaamu jyeshthudu, yehooshu rendavavaadu, eleepeletu moodava vaadu.
oolaamu kumaarulu viluvidyayandu praveenulaina paraakramashaalulu; veeriki noota yebadhimandi kumaaru lunu kumaarula kumaarulunu kaligiri; veerandarunu benyaa meeneeyulu.

ee prakaaramu ishraayeleeyulandarunu thama vanshamulachoppuna sarichoodabadinameedata vaaripellu ishraayeluraajula granthamandu vraayabadenu. yoodhaa vaaru chesina drohamunakai vaaru baabelunaku cheragoni pobadiri.
thama svaasthyamulaina pattanamulalo munupu kaapuramunna vaarevaranagaa ishraayeleeyulunu yaajaku lunu leveeyulunu netheeneeyulunu.
yoodhaavaarilonu benyaameeneeyulalonu ephraayimu manashshe sambandhulalonu yerooshalemunandu kaapuramunna vaarevaranagaa
yoodhaa kumaarudaina peresu santhathivaadagu baanee kumaarudaina imeeki puttina omee kumaarudagu ameehoodunaku jananamaina oothaiyu.
shiloneeyula peddavaadaina aashaayaayu vaani pillalunu.
jerahu santhathivaarilo yevuyelu vaani sahodarulaina aaruvandala tombadhi mandi,
benyaameeneeyulalo senooyaa kumaarudaina hodavyaaku puttina meshullaamu kumaarudagu sallu,
yerohaamu kumaarudaina ibneyaa, mikriki puttina ujjee kumaarudaina elaa, ibneeyaa kumaarudaina ragoovelunaku puttina shephatyaa kumaarudagu meshullaamu.
veerunu veerisahodarulunu thama thama vanshamula patteela choppuna tommidivandala ebadhi aaruguru; ee manushyulandarunu thama pitharula vanshamulanubatti thama pitharula yindlaku peddalu.
yaajakulalo yedaayaa yehoyaareebu yaakeenu,
dhevuni mandiramulo adhipathiyaina ahee toobu kumaarudaina meraayothunaku puttina saadoku kumaarudagu meshullaamunaku kaligina hilkeeyaa kumaarudaina ajaryaa;

malkeeyaa kumaarudagu pasoorunaku puttina yerohaamu kumaarudaina adaayaa immeru kumaarudaina meshillemeethu naku puttina meshullaamunaku kumaarudaina yahajeraaku jananamaina adeeyelu kumaarudagu mashai.
mariyu thama pitharula yindlaku peddalaina veyyinni yeduvandala aruvadhi mandi kutumbikulu. Veeru dhevuni mandirasevaa sambandhamaina kaaryamulayandu manchi gattivaaru.
mariyu leveeyulalo meraari santhathivaadaina hashabyaa kumaarudagu ajreekaamunaku puttina hashshoobu kumaarudaina shemayaa,
bakbakkaru, hereshu, gaalaalu, aasaapu kumaarudagu jikhreeki puttina meekaa kumaarudaina matthanyaa,
yadoothoonu kumaaru daina gaalaalunaku puttina shemayaa kumaarudaina obadyaa, netopaatheeyula graamamulalo kaapuramunna elkaanaa kumaarudaina aasaaku puttina berekyaa.
dvaarapaalakulu evaranagaa shalloomu akkoobu talmonu aheemaanu anuvaarunu vaari saho darulunu. Veerilo shalloomu pedda.
leveeyula samooha mulalo veeru thoorpunanundu raaju gummamunoddha intha varaku kaapuramu cheyuchunnaaru.

mariyu korahu kumaarudagu ebyaasaapunaku puttina kore kumaarudaina shalloomunu vaani pitharuni yintivaarunu vaani saho darulagu koraheeyulunu sevaasambandhamaina panimeedanundi gudaaramunaku dvaarapaalakulai yundiri; vaari pitharulu yehovaa paalemunaku kaavalivaarai yundi pravesha sthalamunu kaayuchundiri.
eliyaajaru kumaarudaina pheenehaasu munupu vaarimeeda adhikaariyai yundenu, yehovaa athanithookooda nundenu.
mariyu meshelemyaa kumaarudaina jekaryaa samaajapu gudaaramuyokka dvaaramunaku kaavali.

gummamulayoddha dvaarapaalakulugaa erpadina veerandaru renduvandala panniddaru; veeru thama graamamula varusanu thama vamshaavali choppuna sarichoodabadiri; veeru nammadaginavaarani daaveedunu deerghadarshiyagu samooyelunu veerini niyaminchiri.
vaarikini vaari kumaaru lakunu yehovaa mandirapu gummamulaku, anagaa gudaa rapu mandiramuyokka gummamulaku vanthula choppuna kaavalikaayu pani galigiyundenu.
gummamula kaavali vaaru naalugu dishalanu, anagaa thoorpunanu padamaranu uttharamunanu dakshinamunanu undiri.
vaari sahodarulu thama graamamulalonundi yedesi dinamula kokasaarivaariyoddhaku vachutakaddu.
leveeyulaina naluguru pradhaana dvaarapaalakulu uttharavaadulai yundiri; dhevuni mandirapu gadulameedanu bokkasamulameedanu aa leveeyulu unchabadiyundiri.
vaaru dhevuni mandiramunaku kaavalivaaru ganuka vaari kaapuramulu daanichuttu undenu. Prathi udayamuna mandirapu vaakindlanu terachupani vaaridhe.
vaarilo kondaru sevopakaranamulanu kanipettu vaaru, vaaru lekkachoppuna vaatini lopaliki konipovalenu, lekka choppuna velupaliki theesikoni raavalenu.
mariyu vaarilo kondaru migilina saamagrimeedanu pari shudhdhamaina paatralannitimeedanu unchabadiyundiri; sannapu pindiyu draakshaarasamunu nooneyu dhoopa vargamunu vaari adheenamu cheyabadenu.
yaajakula kumaaru lalo kondaru sugandhavargamulanu parimalathailamunu cheyu duru.
leveeyulalo korahu santhathivaadaina shalloomunaku pedda kumaarudaina matthityaa pindivantala meeda nunchabadenu.
vaari sahodarulagu kahaatheeyulalo kondariki vishraanthi dinamuna samukhapu rottelu siddhamu cheyu pani kaligiyundenu.
leveeyula pitharulalo peddalaina gaayakulu raatrimbagallu pani vichaarana kaligiyunna hethuvuchetha vaaru kadama panula vichaaranalekunda thama gadulalonundiri.
veeru thama vanshapatteela choppuna leveeyula pitharulalo peddalainavaaru. Veeru yerooshalemunandu kaapuramundiri.
gibiyonu thandri yaina yeheeyelu gibiyonulo kaapuramundenu, athani bhaaryaperu mayakaa.
ithani pedda kumaarudu abdonu; sooru keeshu bayalu neru naadaabu
gedoru ahyo jekaryaa miklothu tharuvaatha puttinavaaru.
miklothu shimyaanunu kanenu. Veeru yerooshalemu vaasulagu thama sahodarulathoo kooda thama sahodarulaku edurugaa nunna yindlalone kaapuramundiri.
neru keeshunu kanenu, keeshu saulunu kanenu, saulu yonaathaanunu malkeeshoovanu abeenaadaabunu eshbayalunu kanenu.
yonaathaanu kumaarudu mereebbayalu, mereebbayalu meekaanu kanenu.
meekaa kumaarulu peethoonu meleku thareya (aahaaju.)
aahaaju yaraanu kanenu; yaraa aalemethunu ajmaavethunu jimeeni kanenu, jimee mojaanu kanenu.
mojaa binyaanu kanenu, rephaayaa binyaaku kumaarudu, elaashaa rephaayaaku kumaarudu, aajelu elaashaaku kumaarudu.
aajelunaku aaruguru kumaaru lundiri; vaaru ajreekaamu bokeru ishmaayelu sheyaryaa obadyaa haanaanu anu pellugalavaaru; veeru aajelu kumaarulu.
philishtheeyulu ishraayeleeyulathoo yuddhamucheyagaa ishraayeleeyulu philishtheeyulayeduta niluvaleka paaripoyi hathulai gilbova parvathamandu padiri.
philishthee yulu saulunu athani kumaarulanu tharimi saulu kumaarulaina yonaathaanunu, abeenaadaabunu malkeeshoovanu hathamuchesiri.
yuddhamulo saulu odipovuchundenu. Athadu ambulu veyuvaari kantabadi vaarichetha bahu gaayamula nondhenu.

appudu saulu'ee sunnathi leni janulu vachi naaku maanabhangamu cheyakunda neevu nee katthidoosi nannu podichiveyumani thana aayudhamulanu moyuvaanithoonanagaa, vaadu bahugaa bhayapadi aalaagu cheyutaku oppaledu ganuka saulu thana katthimeedapadenu.
saulu chanipoyenani aayudhamulanu moyuvaadu telisi koni thaanunu katthini pattukoni daanimeedapadi chacchenu.
aa prakaarame saulunu athani mugguru kumaarulunu chachiri. Mariyu athani yinti vaarandarunu chachiri.
janulu paaripoyiraniyu, saulunu athani kumaarulunu chanipoyiraniyu, loyaloni ishraayeleeyulandaru telisikoni thama pattanamulu vidichi paaripogaa philishtheeyulu vachi vaatilo kaapuramundiri.
hathulainavaarini dochukonutakai philishtheeyulu marunaadu vachinappudu vaaru saulunu athani kumaarulunu gilbova parvathamandu chachi padiyunduta chuchi
athani kavachamunu dochukoni, athani thalanu athani aayudha mulanu theesikoni poyi philishtheeyula dheshamanthata vaatini trippi, jariginadaanini vigrahamulakunu janulakunu chaatinchiri.
vaaru athani aayudhamulanu thama dhevuni gudilo petti athani thalanu daagonu gudilo thagilinchiri.
philishtheeyulu saulunaku chesinadanthayu yaabeshgilaaduvaaru vini nappudu paraakramashaalulainavaarandarunu lechipoyi,
saulu shavamunu athani kumaarula shavamulanu theesikoni yaabeshunakuvachi vaari yemukalanu yaabeshunandali sindooravrukshamu krinda paathipetti yedudinamulu upa vaasamundiri.
ee prakaaramu yehovaa aagnagaikonaka aayana drushti yeduta drohamu chesinandukunu, yehovaayoddha vichaaranacheyaka karnapishaachamula yoddha vichaaranacheyudaanini vedakinandukunu saulu hathamaayenu.
andunimitthamu yehovaa athaniki maranashiksha vidhinchi raajyamunu yeshshayi kumaarudaina daaveedu vashamu chesenu.
appudu ishraayeleeyulandarunu hebronulo nundu daaveedunoddhaku koodi vachichitthagiṁ chumu, memu neeku emukanantinavaaramu rakthasambandhulamu.

inthaku mundu saulu raajaiyunnappudu neevu ishraayeleeyulanu nadipinchuvaadavai yuntivinaa janulagu ishraayelee yulanu neevu eli vaarimeeda adhipathigaa unduvani nee dhevudaina yehovaa neeku selavicchenu ani manavichesiri.

ishraayeleeyula peddalandarunu hebronulonunna raaju noddhaku raagaa daaveedu hebronulo yehovaa sannidhini vaarithoo nibandhanachesenu; appudu vaaru samoo yeludvaaraa yehovaa selavichina prakaaramu daaveedunu ishraayeleeyulameeda raajugaa abhishekamu chesiri.
tharuvaatha daaveedunu ishraayeleeyulandarunu yerooshale manabadina yeboosunaku poyiri; aa dheshavaasulaina yebooseeyulu acchata undiri.
appuduneevu veeniyandu praveshimpakoodadani yeboosu kaapurasthulu daaveeduthoo anagaa daaveedu daaveedu pattanamanabadina seeyonu kotanu pattukonenu.
evadu modata yeboo seeyulanu hathamu cheyuno vaadu mukhyudunu sainyaadhipathiyunagunani daaveedu selaviyyagaa serooyaa kumaarudaina yovaabu andarikante mundhugaa ekki aa yaadhipatyamunu pondhenu.
tharuvaatha daaveedu aa kotayandu nivaasamu chesinanduna daaniki daaveedupuramanu peru kaligenu.
daaveedu millo modalukoni chuttunu pattanamunu kattinchenu; yovaabu pattanamulo migilina bhaagamulanu baaguchesenu.
sainyamula kadhipathiyagu yehovaa athaniki thoodaiyundagaa daaveedu ee prakaaramu anthakanthaku adhikudaguchundenu.

ishraayeleeyulaku yehovaa selavichina prakaa ramu daaveedunu pattaabhishekamu cheyutakai athani raajyamu nandu athanithoonu ishraayeleeyulandarithoonu koodi sahaayamuchesina daaveedunoddhanunna paraakramashaalulaina vaarilo pradhaanulu veeru.

daaveedu noddhanundina aa paraakramashaalula patteelonivaaru muppadhimandi; vaarilo hakmonee kumaarudaina yaashaabaamu mukhyudu;ithadu oka yuddhamandu moodu vandalamandhini champi vaarimeeda eete aadinchinavaadu.
ithani tharuvaathivaadu ahoheeyudagu dodokumaarudaina eliyaajaru; ithadu paraakrama shaalulani perupondina muggurilo okadu.
philishtheeyulu daanininda yavalugala chenu unna pasdameemamulo yuddhamu cheyutakai koodiraagaa janulu philishtheeyulanu chuchi paaripoyinappudu ithadu daaveeduthookooda acchata undenu.
veeru aa chenilo nilichi daani kaapaadi philishtheeyulanu hathamucheyagaa yehovaa janulaku goppa rakshana kalugajesenu.
muppadhimandi paraakrama shaalulalo mukhyulagu ee mugguru adullaamu anu chattu raathikonda guhalo nundu daaveedu noddhaku vachiri, philishtheeyula samoohamu rephaayeeyula loyalo digi yundenu.
daaveedu marugu sthalamandundagaa philishtheeyula dandu betlehemunandundenu.
daaveedu aashapadibetlehemunandali oori gaviniyoddi baavineellu konchemu naaku daahamunaku evadu techiyichunani anagaa

aa muggurunu philishtheeyula danduloniki corabadi poyi betlehemu oori gaviniyoddi baavineellu chedukoni daaveedunoddhaku theesikoni vachiri. Ayithe daaveedu aa neellu traagutaku manassuleka yehovaaku arpithamugaa vaatini paarabosi

nenu eelaagu cheyakunda naa dhevudu nannu kaachunugaaka; praanamunaku teginchi yee neellu techina yee manushyula rakthamunu nenu traagudunaa ani cheppi traagakapoyenu; ee mugguru paraa kramashaalulu itti panulu chesiri.
yovaabu sahodarudaina abeeshai muggurilo pradhaanudu; ithadu oka yuddhamandu mooduvandalamandhini hathamuchesi thana yeete vaarimeeda aadinchinavaadai yee muggurilonu perupondina vaadaayenu.
ee muggurilonu kadama yiddarikante athadu ghanathanondinavaadai vaariki adhipathiyaayenu gaani aa modati muggurilo evarikini athadu saativaadu kaaledu.

mariyu kabseyelu sambandhudunu paraa kramavanthudunaina yokaniki puttina yehoyaadaa kumaarudaina benaayaayunu vikramakriyalavalana goppa vaadaayenu. Ithadu moyaabeeyudagu areeyelu kumaa rula niddarini champenu;mariyu ithadu bayaludheri himamu padina kaalamuna oka simhamunu oka guhayandu champi vesenu.

ayidu moorala podavugala manchiyetthariyaina aiguptheeyuni okani athadu chaavagottenu; aa aiguptheeyuni chethilo nethagaani donevanti yeete yokati yundagaa ithadu oka duddukarra chetha pattukoni vaanimeedikipoyi aa yeetenu aiguptheeyuni chethilonundi ooda laagi daanithoo vaanini champenu.
yehoyaadaa kumaarudaina benaayaa yitti panulu chesinanduna aa mugguru paraakramashaalulalo ghanathanondina vaadaayenu.
muppadhimandilonu ithadu vaasikekkenu gaani aa muggurilo evarikini saativaadu kaaledu; daaveedu ithanini thana dhehasanrakshakula kadhipathigaa unchenu.
mariyu sainyamulaku cherina veru paraakramashaalu levaranagaa yovaabu thammudaina ashaahelu; betlehemu oorivaadaina dodo kumaarudagu el'haanaanu,
haro reeyudaina shammothu, peloneeyudaina helessu,
teko veeyudaina ikkeshu kumaarudagu eeraa, annethootheeyudaina abeeyejeru,
hushaatheeyudaina sibbekai, aho heeyudaina eelai,
netopaatheeyudaina maharai, netopaatheeyudaina bayanaa kumaarudagu heledu,
benyaameeneeyula sthaanamuloni gibiyaa oorivaadunu reebaiki kumaarudunagu eethayi, piraathooneeyudaina benaayaa,
gaayashuthooyavaadaina hoorai, arbaatheeyudaina abeeyelu,
baharoomeeyudaina ajmaavethu, shayilboneeyudaina elyaahbaa,
gijoneeyudaina haashemu kumaarulu, haraareeyudaina shaage kumaarudagu yonaa thaanu,
haraareeyudaina shaakaaru kumaarudagu ahee yaamu, ooru kumaarudaina eleepaalu,
mekeraatheeyudaina heperu, peloneeyudaina aheeyaa,
karmeleeyudaina hejro, ejbayi kumaarudaina nayarai,
naathaanu sahodarudaina yovelu, hagreeyudaina mib'haaru,
ammoneeyudaina jeleku,serooyaa kumaarudai yovaabu yokka aayudhamulu moyuvaadunu berotheeyudunagu naharai,
itreeyudaina eeraa, itreeyudaina gaarebu,
hittheeyudaina ooriyaa, ahlayi kumaarudaina jaabaadu,
roobeneeyudaina sheejaa kumaarudunu roobe neeyulaku peddayunaina adeenaa, athanithootivaaragu muppadhimandi,
mayakaa kumaarudaina haanaanu, mitnee yudaina yehoshaapaathu,
aashteraatheeyudaina ujjeeyaa, aroyereeyudaina hothaanu kumaarulagu shaamaa yeheeyelu,
shimee kumaarudaina yedeeyavelu, thijeeyudaina vaani sahodarudagu yohaa,
mahaveeyudaina eleeyelu, elnayamu kumaarulaina yereebai yoshavyaa, moyaabeeyudaina itmaa,
eleeyelu obedu, mejobaayaa oorivaadaina yahasheeyelu.

daaveedu keeshu kumaarudaina saulunaku bhayapadiyinkanu daagiyundagaa saulu bandhuvulagu benyaameenee yulalo paraakramashaalulu kondaru daaveedunaku yuddha sahaayamu cheyutakai athaniyoddhaku siklagunaku vachiri.
veeru vilukaandrayi kudi yedama chethulathoo vadiselachetha raallu ruvvutakunu vintichetha ambulu viduchutakunu samarthulaina vaaru.
vaarevaranagaa gibiyaavaadaina shemaayaa kumaarulaina aheeyejeru, ithadu adhipathi; ithani tharuvaathivaadagu yovaashu, ajmaavethu kumaarulaina yejeeyelu, peletu, beraakaa, anethootheeyudaina yehoo,
muppadhimandilo paraakramashaaliyu muppadhi mandiki peddayunaina ishmayaa anu gibiyoneeyudu, yirmeeyaa, yahajeeyelu, yohaanaanu,gedheraathee yudaina yojaabaadu,
eloojai, yereemothu, beyalyaa, shemaryaa, hareepeeyudaina shephatayaa,
koraheeyulagu elkaanaa, yeshsheeyaa, ajarelu, yohejeru, yaashaabaamu,
gedoru oorivaadaina yerohaamu kumaarulagu yohelaa, jebadyaa anuvaarunu.

mariyu gaadeeyulalo paraakramashaalulu kondaru aranyamandu daagiyunna daaveedunoddha cheriri; veeru daalunu eetenu vaadukacheyagala yuddhapraveenulu, simhamukhamuvanti mukhamulu galavaaru, kondalalonundu jinkalantha paada vegamu galavaaru.
vaarevaranagaa modativaadu ejeru, rendavavaadu obadyaa, moodavavaadu eleeyaabu,
naalgavavaadu dushmannaa, ayidavavaadu yirmeeyaa,
aaravavaadu atthayi, yedavavaadu eleeyelu,
enimidava vaadu yohaanaanu, tommidavavaadu eljaabaadu,
padhiyavavaadu yirmeeyaa,padakondavavaadu makbannayi.
gaadeeyulagu veeru sainyamunaku adhipathulai yundiri; vaarilo atyalpudainavaadu noorumandiki adhipathi, atya dhikudainavaadu veyyimandiki adhipathi,
yordaanu gattulameedugaa porli paaruchundu modati nelayandu daanini daatipoyi thoorpuloyalalonu padamatiloyalalonu unna vaarinandarini tharimivesinavaaru veere.
mariyu benyaameeneeyulalo kondarunu yoodhaavaarilo kondarunu daaveedu daagiyunna sthalamunaku vachiri.

daaveedu bayaludheri vaariki edurugaa poyi vaarithoo itlanenumeeru samaadhaanamu kaligi naaku sahaayamucheyutakai naayoddhaku vachiyunnayedala naa hrudayamu meethoo athikiyundunu; atlugaaka naa valana meeku apakaaramediyu kalugaledani yerigi yundiyu, nannu naa shatruvulachethiki appagimpavalenani meeru vachiyunnayedala mana pitharulayokka dhevudu deenini chuchi mimmunu gaddinchunu gaaka.

appudu muppadhimandiki adhipathiyaina amaashai aatmavashudaidaaveedoo, memu neevaaramu; yeshshayi kumaarudaa, memu nee pakshamuna unnaamu; neeku samaadhaanamu kalugunugaaka, samaa dhaanamu kalugunugaaka, nee sahakaarulakunu samaadhaanamu kalugunugaaka,nee dhevude neeku sahaayamu cheyunani palu kagaa daaveedu vaarini cherchukoni vaarini thana dandunaku adhipathulugaa chesenu.

saulumeeda yuddhamucheyaboyina philishtheeyulathoo kooda daaveedu vachinappudu manashshe sambaṁ dhulalo kondarunu athani pakshamucheriri; daaveedu philishthee yulaku sahaayamu cheyakapoyenu, yelayanagaa athadu thana yajamaanudaina saulu pakshamunaku marali thamaku praana haani cheyunani yenchi philishtheeyula adhikaarulu athani pampivesiri.

anthata athadu siklagunaku thirigi povuchundagaa manashshe sambandhulaina adnaa yojaabaadu, yedeeyavelu, mikhaayelu, yojaabaadu, eleehu, jillethai anu manashshe gotrapuvaariki adhipathulu athani pakshamucheriri.
vaarandarunu paraakrama shaalulunu sainyaadhipathulunai yundiri; aa dandunu hathamucheyutaku vaaru daaveedunaku sahaayamuchesiri.
daaveedu dandu dhevuni sainyamuvale mahaasainyamagunatlu prathidinamuna athaniki sahaayamu cheyuvaaru athaniyoddhaku vachu chundiri.

yehovaa notimaata prakaaramu sauluyokka raajyamunu daaveeduthattu trippavalenanna prayatnamuthoo yuddhamunakai aayudhamulanu dharinchi athaniyoddhaku hebronunaku vachina adhipathula lekka yenthayanagaa
yoodhaavaarilo daalunu eetenu pattukoni yuddhasannaddhulai yunnavaaru aaruvela enimidivandalamandi.
shimyoneeyulalo yuddha munaku thaginashoorulu eduvela noorumandi.
leveeyulalo attivaaru naaluguvela aaruvandalamandi.
aharonu santhathivaariki yehoyaadaa adhipathi, athanithookooda unnavaaru mooduvela edu vandalamandi.
paraakramashaaliyaina saadoku anu ¸yauvanunithoo kooda athani thandri yintivaaraina adhipathulu iruvadhiyiddaru.
saulu sambandhulagu benyaa meeneeyulu mooduvelamandi; appativaraku vaarilo bahumandi saulu illu gaapaaduchundiri.
thamapitharula yintivaarilo perupondina paraakramashaalulu ephraayimeeyulalo iruvadhivela enimidi vandalamandi.
manashshe yokka ardhagotrapu vaarilo daaveedunu raajugaa cheyutakai raavalenani peru perugaa niyamimpabadinavaaru padunenimidivelamandi.
ishshaakhaareeyulalo samayochitha gnaanamukaligi ishraayeleeyulu cheyathaginadhedo daani nerigiyunna adhipathulu renduvandalu; veeri gotrapu vaarandarunu veeri yaagnaku baddhulaiyundiri.
jebooloo neeyulalo sakalavidhamaina yuddhaayudhamulanu dharinchi yuddhamunaku podaginavaarunu yuddhapu nerpugalavaarunu manassunandu porapulekunda yuddhamu cheyagalavaarunu ebadhivelamandi.
naphthaaleeyulalo veyyimandi adhipathulu, vaarithookooda daalunu eetenu pattukonina vaaru muppadhi yeduvelamandi.
daaneeyulalo yuddha sannaddhulaina vaaru iruvadhi yenimidivela aaru vandala mandi.
aashereeyulalo yuddhapu nerpugala yuddha sannaddhulu naluvadhi velamandi.

mariyu yordaanu nadhi avathalanundu roobeneeyulalonu gaadeeyulalonu manashshe ardhagotrapu vaarilonu sakalavidhamaina yuddhaayudhamulanu dharinchu yuddhashoorulaina yee yodhulandaru daaveedunu ishraayelumeeda raajugaa niyaminchavalenanna korika hrudayamandu kaliginavaarai aayudhamulanu dharinchi hebronunaku vachiri.
ishraayelulo kadama vaarandarunu ekamanaskulai daaveedunu raajugaa niya mimpavalenani koriyundiri.
vaari sahodarulu vaarikoraku bhojanapadaarthamulanu siddhamu chesiyundagaa vaaru daaveeduthookooda acchata moodu dinamulundi anna paanamulu puchukoniri.

ishraayeleeyulaku santhooshamu kaligiyundenu ganuka ishshaakhaaru jebooloonu naphthaali anuvaari polimeralavaraku vaariki sameepamainavaaru gaadidalameedanu ontelameedanu kancharagaadidala meedanu eddula meedanu aahaaravasthuvulaina pindivantakamulanu anjoorapu adalanu endina draakshapandla gelalanu draakshaarasamunu noonenu gorrelanu pashuvulanu visthaara mugaa theesikonivachiri.
daaveedu sahasraadhipathulathoonu shathaadhipathulathoonu adhipathulandarithoonu aalochanachesi, samaajamugaa koodina ishraayeleeyulandarithoo eelaagu selavicchenu

ee yochana mee drushtiki anukoolamai mana dhevudaina yehovaa valana kaligina yedala ishraayeleeyula nivaasapradheshamula yandanthata sheshinchiyunna mana sahodarulunu thama pattanamulalonu pallelalonu kaapuramunna yaajakulunu leveeyulunu manathoo koodukonunatlu vaariyoddhaku pampi
mana dhevuni mandasamunu marala manayoddhaku konivatthamu randi; saulu dinamulalo daaniyoddha manamu vichaarana cheyakaye yuntimi.
ee kaaryamu samaa jakulandari drushtiki anukoolamaayenu ganuka janulandarunu aa prakaaramu cheyudumaniri.
kaagaa dhevuni mandasamunu kiryatyaareemunundi theesikoni vachutaku daaveedu aigupthuyokka sheehorunadhi modalukoni hamaathunaku povumaargamuvarakunundu ishraayeleeyulanandarini samakoorchenu.

keroobulamadhya nivaasamucheyu dhevudaina yehovaa naamamu pettabadina aayana mandasamunu yoodhaalonundu kiryatyaareemu anabadina baalaanundi theesikonivachutakai athadunu ishraayeleeyulandarunu acchatiki poyiri.
vaaru dhevuni mandasamunu oka krottha bandimeeda ekkinchi, abeenaadaabu intanundi theesikonivachiri; ujjaayunu ahyoyunu bandini thooliri.
daaveedunu ishraayeleeyulandarunu thama poorna shakthithoo dhevuni sannidhini paatalu paaduchu, sithaaraalanu svaramandalamulanu thamburalanu thaalamulanu vaayinchuchu booralu ooduchundiri.
vaaru keedonu kallamunoddhaku vachinappudu edlaku kaalu jaarinanduna mandasamunu pattukonavalenani ujjaa cheyichaapagaa
yehovaa kopamu athanimeeda ragulukonenu, athadu thana cheyi mandasamu noddhaku chaapagaa aayana athani mottenu ganuka athadu akkadane dhevuni sannidhini chanipoyenu.
yehovaa ujjaanu vinaashanamu cheyuta chuchi daaveedu vyaakula padenu; anduchetha aa sthalamunaku netivaraku perej‌ ujjaa ani peru.
aa dinamuna daaveedu dhevuni vishayamai bhayamondidhevuni mandasamunu naayoddhaku nenu elaagu theesikoni povudunanukoni, mandasamunu
thana yoddhaku daaveedu puramunaku theesikonipoka, daanini gittheeyu daina obededomu intiloniki konipoyenu.
dhevuni mandasamu obededomu intilo athani kutumbamunoddha moodu nelalundagaa yehovaa obededomu inti vaarini athani sotthanthatini aasheervadhinchenu.
thooru raajaina heeraamu daaveedunoddhaku doothalanu, athaniki oka yillu kattutakai dhevadaaru mraanulanu, kaasepanivaarini vadlavaarini pampenu.
thana janulagu ishraayeleeyula nimitthamu yehovaa athani raajyamunu unnatha sthithiloniki techinanduna aayana thannu ishraayeleeyulameeda raajugaa sthiraparachenani daaveedu grahinchenu.
pammata yerooshalemunandu daaveedu inka kondaru streelanu vivaahamu chesikoni yinka kumaarulanu kumaarthe lanu kanenu.
yerooshalemunandu athaniki puttina kumaarula peru levanagaa, shammooya shobaabu naathaanu solomonu
ibhaaru eleeshoova elpaaletu
nogahu nepegu yaapheeya
eleeshaamaa beyelyedaa eleepeletu.
daaveedu ishraayeleeyulandarimeeda raajugaa abhishekamu cheyaba denani vini, philishtheeyulandaru daaveedunu vedaki pattukonutakai bayaludheragaa daaveedu aa sangathi vini vaarini edurkonaboyenu.
philishtheeyulu vachi rephaayeemula loyalodigiri.

philishtheeyulameediki nenu poyinayedala neevu vaarini naa chethiki appaginchuduvaa? Ani daaveedu dhevuniyoddha vichaaranacheyagaa yehovaapommu, nenu vaarini nee chethiki appaginchedhanani sela vicchenu.

vaaru bayalperaajeemunaku vachinappudu daaveedu acchata vaarini hathamuchesijalapravaahamulu kottukoni povunatlu yehovaa naa shatruvulanu naa yeduta niluvakunda naashanamu chesenanukoni aa sthalamunaku bayalperaajeemu anu perupettenu.
vaaru acchata thama dhevathalanu vidichipettipogaa vaatini agnichetha kaalchi veyavalenani daaveedu selavicchenu.
philishtheeyulu marala aa loyaloniki digiraagaa
daaveedu thirigi dhevuniyoddha vichaaranachesenu. Anduku dhevuduneevu vaarini tharumu konipoka vaarini thappinchukoni chuttu thirigi kambalichetlaku edurugaa nilichi

kambalichetla konalayandu kaallachappudu neeku vinabadunappudu vaarithoo yuddhamu kaluputakai bayaludheri vaarimeeda padumu; aa chappudu vinabadunappudu philishtheeyula dandunu hathamu cheyutakai dhevudu neeku mundhugaa bayaluvelli yunnaadani telisikonumani sela vicchenu.
dhevudu thanaku selavichina prakaaramu daaveedu cheyagaa ishraayeleeyulu philishtheeyula sainyamunu gibi yonu modalukoni gaajeruvaraku tharimi hathamuchesiri.
kaabatti daaveedu keerthi ishraayeleeyula pradheshamulandanthata prasiddhiyaayenu; yehovaa athani bhayamu anyajanula kandariki kalugajesenu.
daaveedu thanakoraku daaveedupuramandu indlu kattinchenu; dhevuni mandasa munaku oka sthalamunu siddhaparachi, daanimeeda gudaaramokati veyinchenu.
mandasamunu etthutakunu nityamu thanaku seva cheyutakunu yehovaa leveeyulanu erparachukonenani cheppivaaru thappa mari evarunu dhevuni mandasamunu etthakoodadani daaveedu aagna icchenu.
anthata daaveedu thaanu yehovaa mandasamunaku siddhaparachina sthalamunaku daani theesikonivachutakai ishraayeleeyulanandarini yerooshalemunaku samaajamugaa koorchenu.
aharonu santhathivaarini
leveeyulaina kahaathu santhathivaari adhipathiyagu ooreeyelunu vaani bandhuvulalo noota iruvadhimandhini,
meraareeyulalo adhipathiyaina ashaayaanu vaani bandhuvulalo renduvandala iruvadhi mandhini,
gershonu santhathivaarikadhipathiyagu yove lunu vaani bandhuvulalo noota muppadhimandhini,
eleeshaapaanu santhathivaarikadhipathiyagu shemayaanu vaani bandhu vulalo renduvandalamandhini,
hebronu santhathivaari kadhipathiyagu eleeyelunu vaani bandhuvulalo enubadhi mandhini
ujjeeyelu santhathivaarikadhipathiyagu amminaa daabunu vaani bandhuvulalo noota pandrendugurini daaveedu samakoorchenu.
anthata daaveedu yaajakulaina saadokunu abyaathaarunu leveeyulaina ooriyelu ashaayaa yovelu shemayaa eleeyelu ammeenaadaabu anuvaarini pilipinchi vaarithoo itlanenu.
leveeyula pitharula santhathulakumeeru peddalai yunnaaru.

inthakumundu meeru ishraayeleeyula dhevudaina yehovaa mandasamunu moyaka yundutachethanu, manamu mana dhevudaina yehovaa yoddha vidhinibatti vichaaranacheyakundutachethanu, aayana manalo naashanamu kalugajesenu; kaavuna ippudu meerunu meevaarunu mimmunu meeru prathishthinchukoni, nenu aa mandasamunaku siddhaparachina sthalamunaku daani thevalenu.
appudu yaajakulunu leveeyulunu ishraayeleeyula dhevudaina yehovaa mandasamunu techutakai thammunu thaamu prathishthinchukoniri.
tharuvaatha leveeyulu yehovaa selavichina maatanubatti moshe aagnaapinchinatlu dhevuni mandasamunu daani dandelathoo thama bhujamula meediki etthikoniri.

anthata daaveedumeeru mee bandhuvulagu paatakulanu pilichi, svaramandalamulu sithaaraalu thaalamulu lonagu vaadyavisheshamulathoo gambheera dhvani cheyuchu, santhooshamuthoo svaramuletthi paadunatlu erpaatucheyudani leveeyula adhipathulaku aagna icchenu.
kaavuna leveeyulu yovelu kumaarudaina hemaanunu, vaani bandhuvulalo berekyaa kumaarudaina aasaapunu, thama bandhuvulagu meraareeyulalo kooshaayaahu kumaarudaina ethaanunu,

veerithookooda rendava varusagaanunna thama bandhuvulaina jekaryaa benu yahajeeyelu shemeeraa mothu yeheeyelu unnee eleeyaabu benaayaa maya sheyaa matthityaa eleeplehu mikneyaahulanuvaarini dvaarapaalakulagu obededomunu yeheeyelunu paataku lanugaa niyaminchiri.
paatakulaina hemaanunu aasaapunu ethaanunu panchalohamula thaalamulu vaayinchutaku nirnayimpabadiri.
jekaryaa ajeeyelu shemeeraamothu yeheeyelu unnee eleeyaabu mayasheyaa benaayaa anuvaaru hechu svaramugala svaramandalamulanu vaayinchutaku nirnayimpabadiri.
mariyu matthityaa eleeplehu mikneyaahu obededomu yeheeyelu ajajyaahu anuvaaru raagametthutakunu sithaaraalu vaayinchutakunu nirnayimpabadiri.
leveeyula kadhipathiyaina kenanyaa mandasamunu moyutayandu gattivaadai nanduna athadu mothakramamu nerputakai niyamimpabadenu.
berekyaayunu elkaanaayunu mandasa munaku mundunaduchu kaavalivaarugaanu

shebanyaa yehoshaapaathu nethanelu amaashai jekaryaa benaayaa eleeyejeru anu yaajakulu dhevuni mandasamunaku mundu booralu ooduvaarugaanu, obededomunu yeheeyaayunu venukathattu kanipettuvaarugaanu niyamimpabadiri.
daaveedunu ishraayeleeyula peddalunu sahasraadhipathulunu yehovaa nibandhana mandasamunu obededomu intilonundi techutakai utsaahamuthoo poyiri.
yehovaa nibandhana mandasamunu moyu leveeyulaku dhevudu sahaayamucheyagaa vaaru edu kode lanu edu gorrapottellanu balulugaa arpinchiri.

daaveedunu mandasamunu moyu leveeyulandarunu paatakulunu paatakula paniki vichaaranakarthayagu kenanyaayunu sannapunaarathoo neyabadina vastramulu dharinchukoni yundiri, daaveedunu sannapu naarathoo neyabadina ephodunu dharinchiyundenu.
ishraayeleeyulandarunu aarbaa étamu cheyuchu, kommulu booralu ooduchu, thaalamulu kottuchu, svaramandalamulu sithaaraalu vaayinchuchu yehovaa nibandhana mandasamunu theesikonivachiri.

yehovaa nibandhana mandasamu daaveedupuramuloniki raagaa saulu kumaartheyaina meekaalu kitikeelonundi chuchi raajaina daaveedu naatyamaadutayu vaayinchutayu kanugoni thana manassulo athani heenaparachenu.
ee prakaaramu vaaru dhevuni mandasamunu theesikoni vachi, daaveedu daanikoraku veyinchiyunna gudaaramu nadumanu daani unchi, dhevuni sannidhini dahanabalulanu samaadhaanabalulanu arpinchiri.
dahanabalulanu samaadhaana balulanu daaveedu arpinchi chaalinchina tharuvaatha athadu yehovaa naamamuna janulanu deevinchi
purushulakemi streelakemi ishraayeleeyulandarilo okkokkariki oka rottenu oka bhakshyamunu oka draakshapandla adanu panchi pettenu.

mariyu athadu yehovaa mandasamu eduta seva cheyuchu, ishraayeleeyula dhevudaina yehovaanu prasiddhi cheyutakunu, vandinchutakunu aaya naku sthootramulu chellinchutakunu leveeyulalo kondarini niyaminchenu.

vaarilo aasaapu adhipathi, jekaryaa athani tharuvaathivaadu, yemeeyelu shemeeraamothu yeheeyelu matthityaa eleeyaabu benaayaa obededomu yeheeyelu anuvaaru svaramandalamulanu sithaaraalanu vaayinchutakai niyamimpabadiri, aasaapu thaalamulanu vaayinchuvaadu.
benaayaa yahajeeyelu anu yaaja kulu eppudunu dhevuni nibandhana mandasamu eduta booralu ooduvaaru.
aa dinamandu yehovaanu sthuthicheyu vichaarananu erparachi, daaveedu aasaapuchethikini vaani bandhuvulachethikini daanini appaginchenu. aa sthuthi vidhamemanagaa
yehovaaku kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellinchudi.aayana naamamunu prakatanacheyudi'aayana kaaryamulanu janamulalo teliyajeyudi.
aayananugoorchi paadudi aayananu keerthinchudi'aayana adbhutha kriyalannitinigoorchi sambhaashana cheyudi.
aayana parishuddha naamamunu batti athishayinchudi yehovaanu vedakuvaaru hrudayamunandu santhoo shinchuduru gaaka.
yehovaanu aashrayinchudi aayana balamu naashrayinchudi'aayana sannidhi nityamu vedakudi.
aayana daasulagu ishraayelu vanshasthulaaraa'aayana erparachukonina yaakobu santhathi vaaralaaraa
aayana chesina aashcharyakaaryamulanu gnaapakamu chesi konudi'aayana soochaka kriyalanu aayana noti theerpulanu gnaapakamu chesikonudi.
aayana mana dhevudaina yehovaa aayana theerpulu bhoomiyandanthata jaruguchunnavi.
mee sankhya koddigaanu meeru svalpasankhyagala janulugaanukanaanu dheshamulo anyulugaanu undagaa kolavabadina svaasthyamugaa daani neekicchedhanani
aayana abraahaamuthoo chesina nibandhananu
issaakuthoo chesina pramaanamunu erpaatunu nityamu gnaapakamunchukonudi.
veyitharamulavaraku aa maata niluchunani aayana sela vicchenu.
yaakobunaku kattadagaanu ishraayelunaku nityanibandhanagaanu aayana aa maatanu sthiraparachiyunnaadu.
vaaru janamunundi janamunakunu raajyamunundiraajyamunakunu thirugulaaduchundagaa
nenu abhishekinchinavaarini muttavaladaniyu naa pravakthalaku keeducheyavaddaniyu selavichi
aayana evarinainanu vaariki hinsacheyaniyyaledu vaari nimitthamu raajulanu gaddinchenu.
sarvabhoojanulaaraa, yehovaanu sannuthinchudi anudinamu aayana rakshananu prakatinchudi.
anyajanulalo aayana mahimanu prachurinchudi samastha janamulalo aayana aashcharyakaaryamulanuprachurinchudi.
yehovaa mahaa ghanatha vahinchinavaadu aayana bahugaa sthuthinonda thaginavaadu samastha dhevathalakante aayana poojyudu.
janamula dhevathalanniyu vatti vigrahamule yehovaa aakaashavaishaalyamunu srujinchinavaadu.
ghanathaaprabhaavamulu aayana sannidhini unnavi balamunu santhooshamunu aayanayoddha unnavi.
janamula kutumbamulaaraa, yehovaaku chellinchudi. Mahimaabalamunu yehovaaku chellinchudi.

yehovaa naamamunaku thagina mahimanu aayanaku chellinchudi naivedyamulu chetha puchukoni aayana sannidhini cherudi parishuddhaalankaaramulagu aabharanamulanu dharinchukoni aayana yeduta saagilapadudi.
bhoojanulaaraa, aayana sannidhini vanakudi appudu bhoolokamu kadalakundunu appudadhi sthiraparachabadunu.
yehovaa eluchunnaadani janamulalo chaatinchudi. aakaashamulu aanandinchunugaaka bhoomi santhooshinchunugaaka
samudramunu daani sampoornathayu ghoshinchunugaaka polamulunu vaatiyandundu sarvamunu santhooshinchunugaaka. Yehovaa vencheyuchunnaadu.
bhoojanulaku theerpu theerchutakai yehovaa vencheyuchunnaadu vanavrukshamulu aayana sannidhini utsayinchunu.
yehovaa dayaaludu, aayana krupa nirantharamundunu. aayananu sthuthinchudi.
dhevaa maa rakshakaa, mammunu rakshinchumu mammunu cherchukonumu.

memu nee parishuddhanaamamunaku kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellinchunatlu ninnu sthuthinchuchu athishayinchunatlu anyajanula vashamulonundi mammunu vidipimpumu. Ani aayananu bathimaalukonudi. Ishraayeleeyulaku dhevudaina yehovaa yugamulannitanu sthootramu nondunugaaka. eelaaguna vaaru paadagaa janulandaru aamen‌ ani cheppi yehovaanu sthuthinchiri.

appudu mandasamu mundhara nityamunu kaavalasina anudina seva jaruputakai daaveedu acchata yehovaa nibandhana mandasamumeeda aasaapunu athani sahodarulanu niyaminchenu. obede domunu vaari sahodarulaina aruvadhi enimidi mandhini
yedoothoonu kumaarudaina obededomunu hosaanu dvaarapaalakulugaa niyaminchenu
gibiyonuloni unnathasthalamunanunna yehovaa gudaaramumeedanu acchati balipeethamumeedanu yehovaa ishraayeleeyulaku aagnaapinchina dharmashaastramandu vraayabadiyunna prakaaramu
udayaasthamayamulayandu anudinamuna nityamaina dahanabalini aayanaku arpinchutakai acchata athadu yaajakudaina saadokunu athani sahodarulaina yaajakulanu niyaminchenu.
yehovaa krupa nityamundunani aayananu sthuthicheyutakai veerithookooda hemaanunu yedoothoonunu pellavarusanu udaaharimpabadina mari kondarini niyaminchenu.

booralu oodutakunu thaalamulanu vaayinchutakunu dhevunigoorchi paadathagina geethamu lanu vaadyamulathoo vinipinchutakunu veerilonundu hemaanunu yedoothoonunu athadu niyaminchenu.Mariyu yedoothoonu kumaarulanu athadu dvaara paalakulugaa niyaminchenu.
tharuvaatha janulandarunu thamathama yindlaku vellipoyiri; daaveedunu thana yinti vaarini deevinchutakai vaariyoddhaku poyenu.

daaveedu thana yinta nundi pravakthayaina naathaanunu pilipinchinenu dhevadaaru mraanulathoo kattabadina nagarulo nivaasamu cheyuchunnaanu; yehovaa nibandhana mandasamu teralachaatuna nunnadani cheppagaa
naathaanudhevudu neeku thoodaiyunnaadu, nee hrudayamandunna danthayu cheyumani daaveeduthoo anenu.
aa raatriyandu dhevunivaakku naathaanunaku pratyakshamai yeelaagu selavicchenu.
neevu poyi naa sevakudaina daaveeduthoo itlanumu yehovaa selavichunadhemanagaa naa nivaasa munakai yoka aalayamu kattinchuta neechethakaadu.
ishraayeleeyulanu rappinchina naatanundi netivaraku nenu oka yintilo nivaasamu cheyaka, okaanoka gudaaramulonu okaanoka deraalonu nivaasamu chesithini.

nenu ishraayeleeyulandari madhyanu sancharinchina kaalamanthayumeeru naakoraku dhevadaarumraanulathoo aalayamu katta kuntiremiyani, naa janamunu mepavalasinadani nenu aagnaa pinchina ishraayeleeyula nyaayaadhipathulalo evarithoo nainanu nenoka maatayaina palikiyuntinaa?

kaavuna neevu naa sevakudaina daaveeduthoo cheppavalasinadhemanagaasainyamulaku adhipathiyagu yehovaa ee prakaaramu selavichuchunnaaduneevu naa janulaina ishraayeleeyula meeda adhipathivai yundunatlu, gorrelavembadi thiruguchunna ninnu gorrela doddinundi theesikoni
neevuvellina chootlanella neeku thoodugaa undi, ninnu dveshinchinavaarini nee mundhara niluvaniyyaka nirmoolamu chesithini; lokamuloni ghanulaku kaligiyunna peruvanti peru neeku kalugajeyudunu

mariyu nenu naa janulaina ishraayeleeyula koraku oka sthalamu erparachi vaarini naatudunu, vaaru mari thirugulaadaka thama sthaanamandu kaapuramunduru, poorvamandu jariginatlunu, naa janulaina ishraayeleeyulameeda nenu nyaayaadhipathulanu nirnayinchina kaalamu modalukoni jaruguchu vachinatlunu, dushtulu vaarini ika shrama pettakunduru;
nee pagavaarinandarini nenu anachi vesedanu. adhiyu gaakayehovaa neeku santhathi kalugajeyunani nenu neeku teliyajesithini.
nee jeevitha dinamulu theeri nee pitharulayoddhaku neevu cherunappudu nee kumaarulavalana kalugu nee santhathini nenu sthaapanachesi athani raajyamunu sthiraparachedanu.
athadu naaku oka mandiramunu kattinchunu, athani sinhaasanamunu nenu nityasthaapana chesedanu.
nenu athaniki thandrinaiyundunu, athadu naaku kumaarudai yundunu; neekante mundhugaa unnavaaniki naa krupanu nenu choopaka maaninatlu athaniki nenu naa krupanu choopaka maananu.
naa mandiramandunu naaraajyamandunu nenu nityamu athani sthiraparachedanu, athani sinhaasanamu ennatikini sthiramugaa nundunani athaniki teliyajeyumu.
naathaanu thanaku pratyakshamainadaanibatti yee maata lannitini daaveedunaku teliyajeyagaa
raajaina daaveedu vachi yehovaa sannidhini koorchundi eelaagu manavi chesenudhevaa yehovaa, neevu nannu intha hechu loniki techutaku nenu enthativaadanu? Naa yillu emaatrapudi?

dhevaa, yidi nee drushtiki svalpavishayame; dhevaa yehovaa, neevu raabovu bahukaalamuvaraku nee sevakuni santhathinigoorchi selavichi, manushyunithoo manu shyudu maatalaadunatlu daya paalinchi naathoo maatalaadi, naa santhathi ghanathajendunani maata yichi yunnaavu.
nee daasudanagu naaku kalugabovu ghanathanu goorchi daaveedanu nee daasuda naina nenu neethoo mari emani manavichesedanu? neevu nee daasuni eruguduvu.
yehovaa nee daasuni nimi tthame nee chitthaprakaaramu ee mahaa ghanatha kalugunani neevu teliyajesiyunnaavu, athani nimitthame neevu ee goppa kaaryamunu chesiyunnaavu.
yehovaa, memu maa chevulathoo vininadanthayu nijamu, neevanti vaadevadunu ledu, neevuthappa mari e dhevudunu ledu.

nee janulaina ishraayeleeyulavanti janamu bhoolokamandu edi? Aigupthulonundi neevu vimochinchina nee janulayeduta niluvaneeyaka neevu aneka janamulanu thoolivesinanduvalana neevu mahaa bhayankaramaina peru techukontivi. Vaaru nee svantha janulagunatlu vaarini vimochinchutakai dhevudavaina neevu bayaludherithivi
nee janulaina ishraayeleeyulu nityamu neeku janulagunatlu nee vaalaaguna chesithivi; yeho vaavaina neevu vaariki dhevudavai yunnaavu
yehovaa, ippudu nee daasunigoorchiyu athani santhathini goorchiyu neevu selavichina maata nityamu sthiramagunu gaaka.

ishraayeleeyula dhevudaina sainyamulaku adhipathiyagu yehovaa ishraayeleeyulaku dhevudaiyunnaadani nee peru ennatikini ghanaparachabadunatlu neevu selavichina maata nishchayamugaa sthiraparachabadunu gaaka; mariyu nee daasudaina daaveedu santhathi nee yeduta sthiraparachabadunugaaka.
dhevaaneeku santhathi kalugajesedhanani nee daasuniki neevu teliya jesiyunnaavu ganuka nee sannidhini vinnapamu cheyutaku nee daasuniki manodhairyamu kaligenu.
yehovaa, neevu dhevudavaiyundi nee daasuniki ee melu dayachesedhanani selavichiyunnaavu.

ippudu nee daasuni santhathi nityamu nee sannidhini undunatlugaa daanini aasheervadhimpa nanugrahinchiyunnaavu. Yehovaa, neevu aasheerva dinchinayedala adhi ennatikini aasheervadhimpabadi yundunu.Idiyaina tharuvaatha daaveedu philishtheeyulanu jayinchi,
vaarini loparachi, gaathu pattanamunu daani graamamulunu philishtheeyula vashamuna nundakunda vaatini pattukonenu.
athadu moyaabeeyulanu jayinchagaa vaaru daaveedunaku kappamukattu daasulairi.
sobaa raajaina hadarejeru yoophrateesunadhivaraku thana raajyamunu vyaapinchutakai bayaludheragaa hamaathunoddha daaveedu athanini odinchi

athani yoddhanundi veyyi rathamulanu eduvela gurrapu rauthulanu iruvadhivela kaalbalamunu pattukonenu. daaveedu aa rathamulalo noorintiki kaavalasina gurramulanu unchukoni kadamavaatikannitiki chilamanda naramulu tegaveyinchenu.
sobaaraajaina hadarejerunaku sahaayamu cheyavalenani damaskuloni siriyanulu raagaa daaveedu aa siri yanulalo iruvadhirendu velamandhini hathamuchesenu.

tharuvaatha daaveedu siriyaa sambandhamaina damaskulo kaavali sainyamunu unchenu; siriyanulu daaveedunaku kappamukattu sevakulairi. ee prakaaramu daaveedu poyina chootlanella yehovaa athaniki sahaayamucheyuchu vacchenu.
mariyu hadarejeru sevakulu pattukoniyunna bangaaru daallanu daaveedu theesikoni yerooshalemunaku cherchenu.

hadarejeruyokka pattanamulaina tib'hathulo nundiyu, koonulonundiyu daaveedu bahu visthaaramaina yitthadini theesikoni vacchenu. daanithoo solomonu itthadi samudramunu sthambhamulunu itthadi vasthuvulanu cheyinchenu.
daaveedu sobaaraajaina hadarejeruyokka sainya manthatini odinchina varthamaanamu hamaathuraajainathoohooku vinabadenu.

hadarejerunakunu thoohookunu virodhamu kaligiyundenu ganuka raajaina daaveedu hadarejeruthoo yuddhamuchesi athani nodinchinandukai daaveeduyokka kshemamu telisikonutakunu, athanithoo shubhavachanamulupalukutakunu, bangaaramuthoonu vendithoonu itthadithoonu cheyabadina sakala vidhamulaina paatralanichi, thoohoo thana kumaarudaina hadoramunu athaniyoddhaku pampenu.

ee vasthuvulanu kooda raajaina daaveedu thaanu edo meeyulayoddhanundiyu, moyaabeeyulayoddha nundiyu, ammoneeyulayoddha nundiyu, philishtheeyula yoddhanundiyu, amaalekeeyulayoddha nundiyu theesikonina vendi bangaaramulathoo paatugaa yehovaaku prathishthinchenu.
mariyu serooyaa kumaarudaina abeeshai uppuloyalo edomeeyulalo padunenimidi vela mandhini hathamu chesenu.
daaveedu edomulo kaavali sainyamunu unchenu, edomeeyulandarunu athaniki sevaku lairi, daaveedu poyina chootlanella yehovaa athani rakshinchenu.
ee prakaaramu daaveedu ishraayeleeyulandarimeedanu raajaiyundi thana janulandarikini neethinyaayamulanu jarigiṁ chenu.
serooyaa kumaarudaina yovaabu sainyaadhipathiyai yundenu; aheeloodu kumaarudaina yehoshaa paathu raajyapu dasthaavejula meeda nundenu;
aheetoobu kumaarudaina saadokunu abyaathaaru kumaarudaina abeemelekunu yaajakulu, shavshaa shaastri;
yehoyaadaa kumaarudaina benaayaa keretheeyulakunu peletheeyulakunu adhipathiyai yundenu; mariyu daaveeduyokka kumaarulu raajunaku sahaayulai yundiri.
idiyaina tharuvaatha ammoneeyula raajaina naahaashu chanipogaa athani kumaarudu athaniki maarugaa raajaayenu.

appudu daaveeduhaanoonu thandriyaina naahaashu naa yedala daya choopinchenu ganuka nenu athanikumaaruni yedala daya choopedhanani yanukoni, athani thandri nimitthamu athani paraamarshinchutaku doothalanu pampenu. daaveedu sevakulu haanoonunu paraamarshinchutakai ammoneeyula dheshamunaku vachinappudu

ammoneeyula yadhi pathulu haanoonuthooninnu paraamarshinchutakai nee yoddhaku daaveedu doothalanu pamputa nee thandrini ghanaparachutake ani neevanukonuchunnaavaa? dheshamunu tharachi chuchi daani naashanamu cheyutakegadaa athani sevakulu neeyoddhaku vachiyunnaaru ani manavi cheyagaa
haanoonu daaveedu sevakulanu pattukoni, vaarini goriginchi, vaari vastramulu pirudulu digakundunatlu nadimiki katthirinchi vaarini pampivesenu.

aa manushyulu intiki vachuchundagaa kondaruvachi vaarini goorchina vaartha daaveedunaku teliyajesiri; vaaru bahu lajjaakraanthulai yundiri ganuka vaariki edurugaa manushyulanu pampimee gaddamulu perugudanuka meeru yerikolo undi tharuvaatha randani raaju vaariki varthamaana mampenu.

ammoneeyulu daaveedunaku thamayandu asahyamu puttinchithimani telisikoninappudu haanoonunu ammoneeyulunu araamnaharayeemu nundiyu, siriyaa mayakaanundiyu sobaanundiyu rathamulanu gurrapurauthulanu renduvela manugula vendi'ichi baadigeku kudurchukoniri.

muppadhi renduvela rathamulathoo vachunatlu jeethamichi mayakaaraajunu athani janulanu kudurchukoniri; veeru vachi medebaa mundarithattuna digiri, ammoneeyulu thamathama pattanamulalonundi koodukoni yuddamucheyutaku vachiri.
daaveedu ee sangathi vini yovaabunu sainyamuloni paraakramashaalula nandarini pampenu.
ammoneeyulu bayaludheri pattanapu gavini yoddha yuddhapankthulu theerchiri, vachina raajulu pratyekamugaa bayata bhoomilo yuddhamunaku siddhamugaa nilichiri.
thaanu rendu sainyamula madhyanu chikkubadi yunduta chuchi, yovaabu ishraayeleeyulaloni shreshthulalo paraakramashaalulanu erparachukoni, siriyanulaku edurugaa vaarini pankthulu theerchi,
kadama janulanu ammoneeyulaku edurugaa vyoohaparachi, thana sahodarudaina abeeshaiki appaginchi yitlanenu
siriyanula balamunaku nenu niluva lekapoyinayedala neevu naaku sahaayamu cheyavalenu, ammoneeyula balamunaku neevu niluvalekapoyinayedala nenu neeku sahaayamu cheyudunu.
dhairyamu kaligiyundumu, manamu mana janula nimitthamunu mana dhevuni pattanamula nimitthamunu dheeratvamu choopudamu; yehovaa thana drushtiki edi manchido daani cheyunugaaka.
aa prakaaramu yovaabunu athanithoo kooda nunna janamunu siriyanulathoo yuddhamu kaluputakai cherapogaa vaaru niluva leka athani yedutanundi thirigi paaripoyiri.
